From the White House to the campaign trail, I've seen it all. I’ve seen historic, monumental wins, but I’ve also seen what happens when campaigns fall short in critical moments like this. Thankfully, I’m told Jacky has one of the strongest grassroots teams in politics, and I’m so glad to hear it.

Do you know what we’re up against, Peter? Races in Nevada ALWAYS come down to the margins. Nevada’s last Senate race (which decided Senate control!) came down to just 7,928 votes – and you know as well as I do that Republicans will do whatever it takes to make sure THAT doesn’t happen again.

# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1477%2E135344%2E_U96Xa)

Hi there.
In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate in Michigan. But before you do, you deserve to know why this request is so important.
In 4 days, we are going to close the books on our May fundraising drive.
And because of a quirk in official FEC reporting that has to do with the presidential race, ActBlue (the platform we, and most Democratic campaigns, use for our online contributions) is now required to file a MONTHLY report detailing how many contributions they bring in.
Instead of making our numbers public every three months, everything our campaign raises online in May will be public – both the total amount and number of donations. Republicans are NOT required to report every month because their online fundraising platform -- WinRed -- is legally structured differently, and therefore subject to different reporting requirements.
That is a considerable advantage for our opponents. They can see where we are, but we are flying blind when it comes to their numbers until the official FEC deadline ends in June.
Practically, that means our opponents will get a sense of whether or not we are vulnerable to attack spending. If we are, they will launch attack ads against our campaign. If we show a strong report, maybe they'll decide to spend that money elsewhere.
So we have an ambitious internal goal we’re hoping to hit for May in order to showcase the strength of our campaign when ActBlue files their report. Yes, because of the reasons above, but also because the fundraising goals we have are what we need to win.
[**Can you contribute $3 to my Senate campaign today? Our average online donation is around $30. Some give more. Others give less. body:
| | | |
---

**CAMPAIGN UPDATES FOR MAY 27, 2024**
**" Our Flag does not fly because the wind moves it. It flies with the last breath of each soldier who died protecting it."** This Memorial Day, we remember the heroic soldiers who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country and our freedom. Their bravery and selflessness stand as a testament to the true spirit of America. Let's honor their memories and be forever grateful for their dedication and service. God Bless the USA.
______________________________________________________ Flemming has the solution to the fentanyl epidemic that's killing our citizens: cut off the supply by securing the border, ramping up penalties for traffickers up to and including the death penalty, and holding China and Mexico responsible for their culpability. Vote for Flemming Larsen for Congress in the June 11th Republican Primary! ______________________________________________________

Team Larsen is busy and running hard! We will continue to bring you the latest news and upcoming events as we push through these last two weeks until the Republican Primary on June 11. Have you registered to vote Republican? Click below to register. _**[Register to Vote Republican](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/A892Sb7CsDrNj0F892QuSZOIiQ/y5mKoapi7763mGHUbT8KEuNQ)**_ Early voting is now in progress. Click the link to determine sites near you: _**[Early Voting Sites / Mail Ballot Drop-Off Locations (May 25-June 7, 2024)](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/dsI9mlYYfRyU1SMn763WVyow/y5mKoapi7763mGHUbT8KEuNQ) **_ _______________________________________________________
| **CANVASSING CONNECTIONS** |
---|---
Team Larsen continues to visit voters daily in the many precincts within CD1. We would love to have you join us out in the community and greatly appreciate your support. If you can take some time to walk your neighborhood to put door knockers on your neighbors doors, please let us know that you want to help! Please reach out to Bette Schanafelt at [bette@larsen4nevada.com](mailto:bette@larsen4nevada.com) or click here: _**[Volunteer](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/DIc3tVOztNHGNBy2jqlnFQ/y5mKoapi7763mGHUbT8KEuNQ) **_ _****_
|
---
**SIGNS & PROMOTING FLEMMING LARSEN**
Team Larsen is still busy putting up signs. Campaign signs influence how we vote more than you might realize. Signs provide a sense of name recognition and convey a sense of viability and electability. Signs are an important part of this campaign, and we need donations to continue pursuing the marketing efforts we have already started. If you would like to contribute by displaying a yard sign, please contact Christina Davis at [christina@larsen4nevada.com](mailto:christina@larsen4nevada.com). If you would like to donate in support of our larger signs, please click here: _**[Donate Today!](https://contact.larsenfornevada.com/l/Bgp56XeTOWHuDL1xwwPvEQ/763kQRKoxFDt2Q5FQdCGETMw/y5mKoapi7763mGHUbT8KEuNQ)**_
|
---
**SOUTHERN HILLS REPUBLICAN WOMEN 'S CLUB LUNCHEON**
Huge thanks to Southern Hills Republican Women's Club for a fantastic candidate forum this past week. Flemming loved talking with so many passionate voters!
|
---
**MEET AND GREET WITH THE CANDIDATES**
| Thank you to the Slater's for hosting a fantastic community meet and greet for your wonderful friends, and neighbors! And a heartfelt thanks to everyone who stopped by to say hello and pick up literature and yards signs. It was inspiring to see such engaged and concerned voters. Your support is truly appreciated!
---

________________________________________________________ **l** **HENDERSON CHAMBER OF COMMERCE MIXER** As a Henderson Chamber of Commerce Foundation Community Cares initiative, HCC participants took part in the ALS Ice Bucket Challenge in memory of Laird Noble Sanders at the mixer. The event had a surpr-ICE-ing show of support for ALS of Nevada.

|
---
**BEST DAM BARBEQUE SPONSORED BY ROTARY CLUB OF BOULDER CITY**

What an incredible weekend at the Best Dam Barbecue and Car Show in Boulder City! A huge thank you to everyone who stopped by to say hello and to all the new supporters of Flemming's Congressional run. Your support means the world to Team Larsen!

Stay connected with our campaign! Hello, I hope that you are enjoying Memorial Day weekend with family and friends. I’ll be not far from a grill myself.

Forward announced a series of endorsements this past week for Congressional candidates! John Avlon (NY-1) and John Curtis running for Mitt Romney’s Senate Seat in Utah may be familiar to you. The other two candidates are Shelane Etchison in North Carolina and Adam Frisch in Colorado.

---
| [ ](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=423d7aa562&e=0f227c2ae3)
---
|
[Shelane Etchison](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=8366421aa4&e=0f227c2ae3) is running as an Independent for Congress in North Carolina’s 9th district. Her bio reads like that of a movie heroine. She served as a Special Operations soldier in the U.S. Army for 11 years, deploying to Iraq, Afghanistan and Syria. After her service, she attended Harvard and returned to North Carolina, where she had been stationed in the Army. Shelane is running out of a deep sense of patriotism: “Our democracy is struggling and needs fresh voices in Congress unbridled by partisan politics.” Shelane would be an independent voice in the House and her victory could make national news.

[Adam Frisch](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=cb688d629b&e=0f227c2ae3) is running in Colorado’s 3rd district – you might remember Adam as the candidate who lost to Lauren Boebert by only about five hundred votes in ’22. Adam’s strength this time daunted Boebert to the point where she switched districts. Now he’s running again to provide a sane, principled voice in Congress unafraid of crossing party lines. I’ve spent time with Adam – we supported him two years ago – and he’ll make a phenomenal member of Congress.

People complain all of the time, “I wish better people ran for office.” These are exactly the kind of people that you want to run. I hope that you will consider supporting [Shelane](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=feeb7422a7&e=0f227c2ae3), [Adam](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=7d545d7601&e=0f227c2ae3), [John](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=76a8f51a7f&e=0f227c2ae3) and [John](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=a022e838a1&e=0f227c2ae3). Let your friends know about them. Let’s help good people who want to reform the system win.

My TED Talk is now over 1,000,000 views – thank you for [sharing](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=56551bf9a7&e=0f227c2ae3) it! I get messages about it every day. [Forward](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=462c4dd9ae&e=0f227c2ae3) is revving up for the summer and hope that you are too. Enjoy the weekend.

---
| **
Andrew Yang**
Co-Chair, Forward Party
[forwardparty.com](https://yangspeaks.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7448319cdb745ea2fd1b1b8a8&id=b95349d0f6&e=0f227c2ae3)

# A Republican Reclamation Project

[Subscribe to Don' Pescis Substack ](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=c29408142b&e=8763c56857)
| Connecticut and national politics is becoming a game of rote and numbers.As part of his 2024 presidential campaign, Joe Biden traveled to Morehead College in Kentucky to reassure Black students that his administration had not forgotten them. Some critics asserted that the Morehouse event had been used by Biden to spread a message to a wider audience – anti-Israeli mobs storming various credulous college student bodies, young voters turning away, according to polls, from their Daddy’s Democrat Party, and a click-dependent left oriented national media.
National polls showing Biden sinking in the estimation of American Black voters put a spring in his faltering 81-year-old step.This, in part, is what Biden said of the Republican Party: The Democrat Party -- not the party of Abe Lincoln and [Frederick Douglass](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=3198c51964&e=8763c56857) \-- is the party of forward movement among Blacks. The Republican Party is anchored in an outmoded past, systemically racist, and led by MAGA Yahoos.Past voting patterns show that Blacks in large cities vote, one might say programmatically, in favor of the Democrat Party. Large cities in the United States such as Chicago and, here in Connecticut, Bridgeport, the state’s most populous city, are Democrat cisterns in which votes are stored and then let loose during campaign seasons.
Connecticut Democrats have only to win massive majorities in the state’s Democrat Party urban reservations, a near certainty, and then harvest a sufficient number of votes in the state’s suburbs to attain office. Such have been the mechanics of politics in Connecticut for the past three decades or more. The last Republican chief executive in Bridgeport was Mary Moran, who left office in 1991. There are no Republicans in Connecticut’s U.S. Congressional Delegation.
Nationally, Democrats favor the elimination of the Electoral College, an important U.S. Constitutional feature that prevents large population centers from exercising permanent political dominion over small states. Perhaps the chief reason Democrats prefer that presidents be elected by a popular vote is that they control large crumbling cities. Presidents elected by votes garnered in larger states and cities may with impunity deny the franchise to smaller states. This arrangement, clearly anti-democratic, seems to satisfy Democrats in Connecticut such as 3rd District congresswoman Rosa DeLauro, who has been in office for 33 years. DeLauro, relying on votes from large cities in her gerrymandered district, has been reelected 16 times, always with more than 56% of the vote.
In its Gerrymander Project, [FiveThirtyEight](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=fc10a63bd9&e=8763c56857) produced an eye-opening map showing “How often we'd expect a party to win each of Connecticut’s 5 seats over the long term — not specifically the 2018 midterms — based on historical patterns since 2006.”
By way of example, U.S. Representative John Larson’s 1st District regularly produces a vote in which the chance of being represented by a Republican is a slender 2.9%, while the chance of being represented by a Democrat is a fulsome 79.1%. In Rosa DeLauro’s 3rd District, the figures are: chance of being represented by a Democrat 94.2%, chance of being represented by a Republican 5.8 %. And in Jim Himes’ 4th District, the figures are: chance of being represented by a Republican 9.9%, chance of being represented by a Democrat 90.1%. The racial or ethnic makeup of all Connecticut Districts is “predominantly White.”
**Republicans have yet to mount a sustained effort to increase Republican chances in Democrat urban fiefdoms by, say, 10% among Blacks, some of whom appear ready to bolt the Democrat Party in 2024.**
But, here in the state, a Republican Party reclamation effort is underway, the brainchild of Dominic Rapini, the talented Republican political polymath who ran for Connecticut Secretary of State in 2022. The Republican Party is historically the party of emancipation under President Abraham Lincoln, the party that, pre-emancipation, opposed fugitive slave laws, the party that resolutely opposed Jim Crow once southern reconstruction had ebbed, the party that promoted both the Civil Rights Act of 1866, a precursor to the 14thAmendment, and the Civil Rights Act of 1964. There can be no doubt that historically, the Republican Party had advanced minority interests ever since the end of the Civil War through modern times.The comically absurd notion that the Republican Party is systemically and objectively racist is not only a slur upon the party; it is a crude attempt to repeal history from the Civil War forward.
**In Branford Connecticut this June 5th, thanks to Republicans mindful of the history of their party, the Branford Republican Town Committee will be hosting its first annual**[**Frederick Douglass Celebration Event**](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=5424821932&e=8763c56857)**. Like Lincoln, Douglass now belongs to history. Both were, in their own day, courageous apostles of liberty, and those of us who know that history is the imprint of the spirit of a country, know also that the undying courage to do right expires when a country’s real history is either forgotten or overlaid with bastardized and fanciful attempts to destroy the past so that the future may conform to destructive ideological modalities.**

# Why Frederick Douglass?
---
| **A Force for Uniting the United States:** Frederick Douglass serves as a powerful symbol for Republicans to promote the values and principles that make our nation unique. He was born into slavery in 1818, but later became one of the leading advocates for reuniting our nation as the Civil War came to an end. His strong conviction in the power of our founding values and constitutional principles, along with his self-learned eloquence, helped guide Abraham Lincoln and the recently formed Republican party to win a second term based on these values and principles. Lincoln faced the daunting challenge of rescuing a nation divided by the Civil War.
**Believed in American Principles:** History tells us that Lincoln's wholehearted embrace of Douglass's message of fighting for and preserving the values that formed our nation was not only the winning message, but also the roadmap for reunification. Today, as our nation becomes increasingly fragmented along political issues and divergent views of our fundamental values and principles of freedom, engaging people based on this former slave's unassailable historical contribution offers the most effective messaging for winning new hearts and minds.
**A Symbol of Republican Values:** Just as Lincoln turned to Douglass for guiding the salvation of America, Republicans can leverage Douglass as a pivotal symbol for fully realizing the greatness of our country. In a historical context, emulating Lincoln and using the impactful legacy of Frederick Douglass serves to open the door to all voters to find common ground and reunite our country.
**Frederick Douglass played a crucial role in the birth of the Republican Party:** The Republican Party was founded in 1854 by abolitionists who aimed to end slavery and advocate for the civil rights of Black people, with Frederick Douglass playing a significant role in initiating the political campaign.

name: Christine Drazan
subject: Honoring our Veterans this Memorial Day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Christine Drazan
body:
Important message inside
Friend,Today we remember those who died in service to our country, and in remembering we resolve to honor them, not just with our words, but with our actions. To stand fast for those same ideals, to require of ourselves a tireless commitment to freedom and liberty for all.In remembering, we honor their faithfulness to country, we honor their courage in battle and we remember their place in the hearts and lives of the families and communities they left behind; who love and miss them still.Freedom is not free and this day to remember is appropriately about family and community, service and memory. It is picnics and campfires, yard work--and a prayer for the families of those who lost loved ones in service to their country. On this Memorial Day it is our honor--our duty--to gather and remember the fallen. We thank them for the freedoms we enjoy and commit to their families that their sacrifice will not be lost to time.We owe them this debt and so much more than the debt of remembrance. We must have the courage to defend the freedoms they sacrificed to uphold. We must stand against those who would casually abuse or cowardly retreat from the preservation of our unalienable rights and constitutionally protected freedoms. We must not abandon our post, but instead continue as the sentinels of a liberty hard won, and once lost, not easily restored.Memorial Day, brings us together once again to remember. For veterans and active duty servicemen and women, who have served alongside those who would not return; for families and friends of those lost to war, we stand with you today to strengthen our collective memory; to remember your lost, and to join with you in honoring their sacrifice.As a grateful nation, forged in war, we strive for peace, but are destined and duty-bound to stand and fight when the cause is just, to defend freedom and liberty at home and abroad. On this sacred day of remembrance may God bless you and God bless America.

With gratitude, Christine Drazan [](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mmdijy-dihkkhuuli-r/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mmdijy-dihkkhuuli-y/)[](https://andor.cmail20.com/t/y-l-mmdijy-dihkkhuuli-j/) Paid for by Friends of Christine Drazan. PAC ID 19050

Happy Memorial Day, everyone.
I was honored to join in parades in Johnstown (in Fulton County) and in Crown Point (in Essex County). It is always delightful to see the various commemorations and expressions honoring our military men and women throughout the North Country. In some areas, it's a solomon occasion. In others, like in Tupper Lake, it's shopping. In still others, it's a parade. Larger towns manage to do some combination of all of the above!
My mother was born in Manila on a U.S. Military Base. She and her siblings survived World War II in hiding in a small village in the mountains. My Filipino grandmother served bravely during the war as a U.S. Army nurse. Sadly, my grandfather, an American military pilot serving in Manila, fell ill in a Japanese POW camp and did not survive. Years later, we discovered that he had been awarded the Purple Heart, with a document signed by FDR. I regret never knowing either of my grandparents, though the stories and heritage certainly shaped my understanding of patriotism, honor, and duty.
The call to service is relevant today as we get closer to the November election.
If you are as concerned about our democracy as I am, the most patriotic act you can take is to get involved. Talk to your neighbors and your relatives. Share your concerns. Ask them about theirs.
Speak positively. The secret to motivating others to exercise their civic duty and vote is to assure them that a) their vote counts, and b) our election process is safe.
Please don't even joke with statements like, "It's a rigged election." Decades ago we had the luxury of such rhetoric; but no longer. Such talk isn't funny, and it isn't helpful. One major-party candidate is already planting the thought that the election results are not to be believed.
If you are speaking to a person who is not politically active, they will not be motivated to go vote if you pepper your conversations with statements like, "We are all screwed," or "Of course, so-and-so will win because they have all the money backing them." Nobody wants to participate in a futile process. A person who is currently not a regular voter will not be encouraged to participate if you focus on the negative.
Let me veer off course a little bit. Our democracy is on proverbial life support. Similarly, if you were to visit a friend in hospice, you wouldn't say to the health care workers, "What's the use? She's terminally ill anyway." Nor would you say, "She's racking up a ton of medical debt here, which the estate won't be able to pay, so I don't know why any of you would bother?" Of course you wouldn't say or do that to or about your terminally ill friend. So don't do it to our democracy. Please.
Back on track. I was talking about voting. Start planning now for how you will vote. There is a primary on June 25, 2024, though there are not a lot of races that will be on the ballot then. You can find out what's on your ballot by [clicking here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/164a17a6-3628-4cfe-85cf-8373e0d81066?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The general election is on November 5, 2024. Think now: will you be in town that day, or do you migrate away from the North Country in the fall? If you are registered to vote, there is plenty of time to [request a mail in ballot. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4126f4a3-c134-4abc-bf1e-4c84f99203c7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Could you possibly work at the polls? It is a paid position, and one which is needed for our elections to run smoothly - or to run at all. Here is a [link to get information](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/32460bbb-d126-45a8-8f44-10de56db1ef4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Back to the scenario in which you are talking to others about participating in the voting process. Are they registered to vote? If not, assure them that it is an easy thing to remedy. They can [register online here](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/91d911fe-89bb-4d69-9a6f-d1e6e97ed07b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). You can even sit with them to make sure they work through the entire process.
Start planning with your friend or neighbor now about how they will get to the polls. Will they have to work that day? Do they know that the polls are open from 6:00am until 9:00pm?
Do they even know where they are supposed to vote? Do they need the link I shared above for a mail in ballot?
If there is a problem at the polls, know that there is help available. For starters, voters can ask the poll workers. If that doesn't work, they can call 1-866-OUR-VOTE. If you forget that number between now and November, you can find it by searching, "Problem at the polls." I worked such a hotline for the 2016 election. The phones were busy for early voting. Not so much the day of the general election. I still wonder why.
Our veterans served proudly. Some gave the ultimate sacrifice, as we commemorated on Memorial Day. Other veterans are living among us, at times needing a robust Veterans Health Administration for physical and mental health needs.
Your vote is needed in this particular election to ensure that our Veterans Health Administration remains robust. The Republicans have promised that if they are restored to power, the Veterans Health Administration will undergo funding cuts, a reduction in staffing, and vital healthcare workers do not lose their ability to collectively bargain.
Your vote, and your ability to encourage others to exercise their right to vote, is a sacred call to service for our country. Please preserve our rights in one nation, under whichever god you choose to call god, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

body:

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Good day,
fellow American.

You are
an informed citizen-I believe that wholeheartedly.

You love
this country. You make an effort to understand what the U.S.
Constitution says and what it means, and you aren't afraid to
stand up for America's founding and the principles of liberty
that define our nation.

Your
leadership and knowledge are needed today…

Do you
believe the American education system is failing millions of
young Americans?
YES
NO

We need
more citizens like you-informed citizens-because America is at a
turning point. Dangerous left-wing ideologies are taking hold
thanks to a decades-long campaign by progressives to attack the
Constitution and undermine liberty and patriotism.

The
country you and I love will be lost forever if we fail to restore
knowledge about the Constitution among our fellow citizens. We
can't let that happen!

That's
why I am writing to you today and asking you to be part of
Hillsdale College and our new, nationwide initiative-the CAMPAIGN
FOR INFORMED CITIZENS.

We are
the foremost educational institution committed to reaching and
teaching millions about freedom and limited government. The goal
of this new campaign is to build generations of knowledgeable
Americans who understand:

WHAT
the Constitution says
HOW
it relates to current issues and events
WHY
the preservation of constitutional principles is essential to
liberty

If this
campaign is successful, we will spread knowledge about the
Constitution among millions of citizens, especially young people,
that our education system failed.

These are
young people that "educators" deliberately deceived or who just
haven't learned about a proper understanding of American history
in school.

You are
essential to the success of this effort to make America more
knowledgeable.

That's
because we're seeking 1,000 people in each state to help us teach
the Constitution and its underlying principles of liberty to
10,000,000 Americans in the coming year, and this initiative
starts with you-YOUR knowledge and YOUR insights.

And we
must do this work without ONE PENNY of federal or state taxpayer
support, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student
grants and loans. Instead, we put our trust in citizens like you
who want what's best for the country.

So
please, share your opinions by completing the National Survey on
the State of American Education today at the link below. Thank
you for reading my email!

children,

Bill
Gray, '01

## Israel Calls Strike a 'Tragic Mistake'
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu acknowledged Monday that [a "tragic mistake"](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L1qxDAQBOCnsTsd8lq_hYo0113alGYlrc8b5B8scUfePjh1ymEY-Jivx_RALrw9P3Gl0OZ9wtT4RZMW4ASoSfU5zERAY09hsINx3ms99ktIycg5SeljQhjGUdmck3XogDwO1vccQIKSGpx02kh3i1pbJIhDlNY7ZTolKXPbz9v3zltbaC4_-4vOW9rXvoSltaN240cH9w7ueGz0rld1hbNxKtTBneuJVMSBhWrjjXGrYsEVq3jjKa6JkFqAFZdF2GjViE45ml2cIxmP3miPCnXOUtn-DPl4cylcje2UfK7I5Y_T_j_nFeA3AAD___00ZII) was made in an Israeli airstrike that set fire to a tent camp in Rafah, killing at least 45 Palestinians. The strike killed two senior Hamas militants, but it appeared to target them in a [humanitarian zone](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOnDAQQL_GdLMygw2moEhDd2lTrmZhfJ6cwSt7tCf-PsrWV73iNU_vz8f9gyTL-fmbDl40ljttKi--e8AA6O6u25fIjDx0vPRTP4Z59n7o0hICbg_X4-ynOexx2Ka-3zn4OI_RTdZ3sqBFZz0GG_xow-3h_USMj_5hpzm40TjLu2ipt79FTk0c81VeXG9bObq8JNVnM8Mvg6vBVRMnyfm_M7g-S5btMrjKqVxPUiknZYOrG8M0jBakVeIscEgWpXpBo6uBKHxJzryDfhdofEqpkOigBiVG2YRyAzmhUqQETat8cQNNpJA5KrxJTWHwsDPtBteuLvvzW3KWNk7G2c-D5F3Z6c8_Xwv-CwAA__80oHm-) where the military had told refugees to shelter from attack. Many were buried under rubble. Israeli officials said they had opened an official investigation into the civilian deaths. _" Despite our utmost efforts not to harm innocent civilians, last night there was a tragic mistake," _Netanyahu told Israel's Parliament on Monday.
## NBA Legend Bill Walton Dead at 71
College basketball legend and NBA Hall of Famer [Bill Walton died](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDGPtCAUAH8Ndhh4gkBB8TV0-7VXGpTn-i4IRsma_feXu2uvnikm8_GYHpEylef_uKNva53i0uiFk-ZgOahJdcmviIBDh14aOVrntB66zS9SO6OFHRW4ZKUzel6dkeCMxTjC0JEHAUposMLqUdh-1tpEhFnOwjirRqYEJmr17D8rlbbhmt_1hWe_1L3LfmvtuNjwj0FgEO777vE6yjdkEMocGYSr1fPNIEwMAiUGQQkAJwb5a_Bli_tBtfAt5szXuOPJZ8qZ3zG3WngivLiR3enTcVPOdI2GKfHcI-Wfivb3k5eHrwAAAP__AZlg3Q) after a prolonged battle with cancer Monday. He was 71. Walton rose to fame as the starting center for the [UCLA Bruins](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0L2O6yAQxfGnwd1YeGL8UVDcxl1uu6U1wBCzwSYCEitvv8rW2_yqUxz9v67rlUIMx-0_7ayrTyvZGl68KsAJsF_7xmnPjHxpWHdjN0zzrNSl2fQ8jwp57iZWSjrygycydlTGzeQUD03QKLGXCic5qUFOrVFqJEbTGTnOUz-IXrILNeX2O4WjbuzjO704tzbtTdRbrY8iLv8ELgKX8zxba0p5pFzLZyFwOQx95LMIXEyIEU6KNR3gAhegCmMHNT_jG9LBkDwQ3MPhwFC5czUUI2wfkgdPO2coT2ufuylQE1g6LGeBS5O1e5whxlCGUfTytlOIvx_r38VeGn8CAAD__2kkcBQ), leading the Bruins to back-to-back national championships in 1972 and 1973. His 44 points in the national championship game in 1973 remain a record. Selected No. 1 overall in the 1974 NBA Draft, Walton went on to play for the Portland Trail Blazers, San Diego Clippers, and Boston Celtics in his 10-year career. He won two NBA championships and a spot on the [NBA's 50th and 75th Anniversary Teams](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHO2yAURp8Gb0T4AsYeGLqwpWtH6wKXhIqAhVEiv32Vzv_2SZ90dHT-3Pc75pLr4ze-yI7Udgwjv2nXHFYOaldTtIkISE5kZzMv67ZpLaenTQgqSR0CCqU3LSVuKQS1LN7IYJKYsgUBSmhYxaoXsd681gYJ_OyF2Va1MCUo5tH67W_LdTwplau9qd9Ce03FPsc4TiZ_MXAMXL2Odo7vxcB9wQyc0N9tGLjzaH2cDJzPpfAPltEqL_SgGrFfvHrkR8GLOscaue8NY8BzUOeRMHIc3MwM3NRtPD65lHwuhinxeGEu_3XGz3HeFv4FAAD__9B2ZaE). Upon retirement, Walton became a top sports broadcaster. He also won notoriety over the years as one of the most famous fans of the Grateful Dead rock band, towering over concertgoers at many of their shows.

| MANAKIN SABOT, VA -- Candidate for Congress, Trump Virginia State Director, former Navy SEAL, and state Senator John McGuire released the following statement after Donald J. Trump announced his endorsement of McGuire's congressional campaign:
"Thank you to President Donald J. Trump for endorsing my campaign for Congress! I've been with Trump since he came down the escalator and when I'm in Congress, I'll back his agenda and put America First! Trump is exactly right about Bob Good. Our country is in dire peril under Biden and we need Trump to Save America. We cannot trust Bob Good. Trump has recognized that I'm the 100% MAGA candidate in this race and I appreciate it. I'm ready to give everything I've got to represent the 5th District effectively and aggressively. Let's crack down on the border, keep woke ideologies out of schools, and protect our crucial 2nd Amendment. President Trump and I will be the voice of We the People in Washington. Please vote McGuire in the June 18 primary!"

President Trump [said (click here)](https://eky6fg9ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NPJkNH7NOw1_J5Al_T0Gxyk4Nff6CcVsRPmLLyG0kfzv0BZs9G7p9fQEI3xChaX7nv-7Pkne59CXIKQ17JVmIN4IVfdVPzBIHmznzRjnmSZMEuUIlDOw6N0mmdjMITSAU-7nzXgVonLdtLBSozAWnXLndGtan8CNnWYMDmsvDJcfk0vJa22Lbjv9lU7o1BGj-ZCKHVEx0TE=&c=Uf20WWJ0U88NC6rUPt4hMJEnlbecyzl4iQcEYbAIiXYKFPeR3Uvhdg==&ch=8ZMSvhUNvHIP8OMyEuOV_0BrAdKHadlfyRHHAWksTL_NxAr9U4tf-A==):
"Bob Good is BAD FOR VIRGINIA, AND BAD FOR THE USA. He turned his back on our incredible movement, and was constantly attacking and fighting me until recently, when he gave a warm and "loving" Endorsement - But really, it was too late. The damage had been done! I just want to MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN, and the person that can most help me do that is Navy SEAL and highly respected State Legislator, John McGuire, a true American Hero. John, who fought the Cartels on the Front Line, and then came home and fought the drug dealers in Virginia, will ALWAYS PUT AMERICA FIRST. I had the safest Border in history, built hundreds of miles of Wall, and then Crooked Joe Biden came along and ruined it, making it one of the worst human catastrophes ever in our Country. John and I will correct this situation, and fast! He is strong on crime, will protect our great Military/Vets, and will always defend our under siege Second Amendment. John McGuire has my Complete and Total Endorsement! MAGA2024"

PLEASE VOTE MCGUIRE IN THE JUNE 18 PRIMARY

## DISASTER BRIEFS, MONDAY, MAY 28, 2024
Global Disaster Briefs are your weekly (or more often, if needed) summaries and headlines from around the world about natural and man-made disasters, climate change, disease and health, and international conflict. See endnotes for resources used in putting this report together. Data is retrieved and summarized on the day of publication unless otherwise noted.
### NEW TO MESOSCALE THIS WEEK
At your request, I'm adding a list of ways you can help those impacted by the disasters and global conflict I write about.
I'm including a[ Charity Navigator](https://substack.com/redirect/67c6959c-a85f-41a2-84b2-d2af7bfefe25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and/or [GuideStar](https://substack.com/redirect/02009821-4eb6-4405-8f50-65b04f0d1c6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rating on each non-profit included. In cases where the most effective remedy is congressional or international legislation or intervention, I'll list the appropriate resources to contact.
This will take a bit more time to include. As always, supporting my work with a donation is always appreciated.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/49376239-1508-4598-939b-b09190d37e97?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
### Meteorological/Climatological
The world experienced its [hottest April on record this year](https://substack.com/redirect/d5d64a82-654b-478c-a835-f83c99977fff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), continuing an 11-month streak of record-breaking monthly temperatures [that started in June 2023](https://substack.com/redirect/f79c0d68-02fd-499e-aff6-1e5a655481ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Intense rains and a flurry of earthquakes caused widespread flooding and landslides in **Papua New Guinea** Friday, with the death toll currently [reported to be above 670](https://substack.com/redirect/a4230656-4d56-4173-ba04-d3b21b67161c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [expected to rise to as many as 2,000](https://substack.com/redirect/d0986d3c-5957-48f2-8a7a-5cc2cc452bde?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) as relief crews continue working.
In March, a 6.9 mag earthquake [killed five people and destroyed hundreds of homes](https://substack.com/redirect/f8937d46-ed16-4021-8850-fb4378a0f703?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in **Papua New Guinea**. In April, at least 25 people were killed after flooding and landslides devastated the nation. As monsoon season continues, losses are expected to increase.
> **Ways to help those impacted by landslides in Papua New Guinea:**
> * [Doctors without Borders](https://substack.com/redirect/58dfe2ef-361d-4502-bce9-444d44d61268?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([98% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/38c56f3d-8077-4e26-ab6f-e5391973772b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)*)
> * [USA for IOM](https://substack.com/redirect/e83411ef-8383-4780-9094-30e31515c347?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([88% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/68e4f5f9-5878-4732-bed1-983785befe17?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [Oxfam](https://substack.com/redirect/7dfd78ba-6526-4239-a4bc-363c6c343767?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([98% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/2fc8faf2-59a8-4223-9f95-39615a4ef15b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [UNICEF](https://substack.com/redirect/a9f2250a-69bf-4b2c-b253-a5811326e5a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([92% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/870c9e0d-11c3-4912-8207-608991f13a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [CARE](https://substack.com/redirect/55a175ab-0556-41b9-99c8-6d6075cb1d8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([97% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/952db3f2-aaf7-4577-9f7a-7962fb5b81bc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
>

> _NOTE: The[Charity Navigator](https://substack.com/redirect/67c6959c-a85f-41a2-84b2-d2af7bfefe25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) rating is shown next to organization name in parenthesis. Click on the organization name to donate; click on the rating to see the breakdown._
Severe drought in **Namibia** entered its 40th week ([breaking the 100-year drought record](https://substack.com/redirect/03a0da02-412f-412c-b145-d6fee3c09344?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) and[ continued drought in ](https://substack.com/redirect/385d5d67-0393-4643-a9a5-93ed08d64b46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[South Africa](https://substack.com/redirect/385d5d67-0393-4643-a9a5-93ed08d64b46?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** have exacerbated food insecurity issues in the region.
> **Ways to help those impacted by food insecurity in Namibia:**
> * [World Food Program USA](https://substack.com/redirect/71a601ef-eb48-4af6-8893-149721bff57c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([90% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/a29f383b-e188-4657-8535-11e9a7918ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [Global Child Nutrition Foundation ](https://substack.com/redirect/8f6ed22e-45af-467b-b504-0b56b840ae57?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)([88% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/8fd7ea64-1e5a-4c86-8fcc-7eb524bd968f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [Nutrition and Food Security Alliance of Namibia](https://substack.com/redirect/bbe62125-1970-4f6e-a647-b533f1d3d4e5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**(** NA- Not registered in the USA, but highly respected in Africa**)**
>

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e3adf711-b06c-4d0b-acf3-7b2d47242cec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Extreme flooding [killed at least three people and caused significant structural damage](https://substack.com/redirect/697f139e-7b08-433b-92d3-b9e6c9815316?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in northern **Armenia** this weekend. [International relief organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/8980a289-3c77-45b8-8add-a13fd7a3a9f4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [allied governments](https://substack.com/redirect/2cd30042-951e-4f1f-9d23-2919669cfba1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have provided supplies and military support for recovery.
#### **Tropical Cyclone Reports**
The Pacific basin tropical cyclone season started May 15; the Atlantic hurricane season starts June 1. Both extend through November 30.
The Atlantic hurricane season this year is predicted to be t[he most intense season since projections began in 1955](https://substack.com/redirect/d7450cda-383d-4973-9804-a727b177dea7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/52674171-c196-4c01-adab-10370223ad74?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The **first landfalling tropical cyclone** in the Indian Ocean basin of the 2024 season struck near the border of India and Bangladesh Sunday,[ killing 16, cutting power to ](https://substack.com/redirect/479ddf61-b556-4ae7-b0d6-7264d91f2611?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)[millions, and forcing the evacuations of more than 800,000 people](https://substack.com/redirect/33520853-b7b5-4d9a-92e7-ac7ed1995564?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Cyclone Remal hit the low-lying area near Monla Port as a strong tropical storm with wind speeds of 67 knots (77 mph).
> **Ways to help those impacted by Cyclone Remal:**
> * [World Food Programme](https://substack.com/redirect/6b51feed-4667-4a70-ad92-d9f409275cbf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([90% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/a29f383b-e188-4657-8535-11e9a7918ce1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)1)
> * [UNICEF](https://substack.com/redirect/e753723b-2808-4c9c-9d17-5610aeedcc33?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([92% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/870c9e0d-11c3-4912-8207-608991f13a25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))
> * [Islamic Relief](https://substack.com/redirect/87e50dff-c19f-486d-9a39-baf75a224f1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ([100% Rating](https://substack.com/redirect/410c4b86-b692-4af7-a006-346434345934?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg))...

body:
I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. My story was told in the film “Sound of Freedom.” But now, I am being PERSECUTED for fighting the good fight and I need your help.

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrdja1aua03pcrt41rhkbg4hls341rsgg2u73uuo_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cji60oj6cth2bs)
---
I see the victims’ faces every time I close my eyes. _“Why, Heavenly Father?”_ I ask God each night. **[I have helped rescue thousands of children and women from sex traffickers. On this week's episode of The Qasim Rashid Show I welcome back [Jamyle Cannon](https://substack.com/redirect/26e59bb2-c95e-4487-b04b-2f9b2f90fc7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the founder and Executive Director of [The Bloc Chicago](https://substack.com/redirect/58c5f5e2-6a63-4ea5-a4ea-6993bc852b32?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Jamyle started The Bloc in 2016 to reach kids who were unengaged by traditional after-school outlets. The Bloc engages youth with the sport of boxing to provide resources and opportunities to young people and their communities. Since its inception, 100% of The Bloc's fighters have graduated high school and earned acceptance into college.
We discuss:
* ICC prosecution of war crimes
* Strengthening communities through boxing, overcoming the 10 year mortality gap in neighboring Chicago zip codes, and what do you do when donors pull funding because you support a ceasefire and release of all hostages? (Yes this actually happened and we need to talk about it).
* Funding public safety goes beyond more money for police

I am praying for you.

I am praying with you.

As a wife, a mother, and a Child of God- prayer is the centerpiece of my life.

Today I prayed for the health of my children & the safety of my husband who is a Border Patrol Agent.

I also prayed for the courage & strength to do something I struggle at- asking others for help.

_So here goes nothing..._

My name is Mayra Flores & I'm a Christian conservative running for Congress in one of the toughest races in America.

I believe that a nation that prays together, stays together & that creates huge problems for Democrats. Their power & their party relies on dividing the nation & pinning God's Children against one another.

And now Joe Biden & the liberal elite are spending millions to shut me UP & shut my campaign DOWN.

After years of dividing our nation by the color of our skin, gender, and our economic status, they know they can't suffer another humiliating defeat by someone like me who uses God's guiding hand to bring people together & mend that divide.

They have endless resources & a grocery list of millionaires to put this race out of our reach.

**[So I'm humbly asking you for your support today before it's too late.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zdqrkcckb058sk9p3qol9gj6brsuea7n5bd6o7c8_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cji6aor1c9h2bs "So I'm humbly asking you for your support today before it's too late.")**

Don Jr.

body:

Friend,

First off, I wanted to reach out and thank you for supporting my reelection campaign. It really means the world to me to see so many folks volunteering, chipping in, or even just taking the time to read these emails from my team and me.

I also wanted to send you a brief update on my must-win Senate race here in Nevada.
For months, polling has shown me locked neck and neck with my extremist GOP opponent.

body:
The House must hold Garland accountable.
| | | |

| Patriot-

| **** ********Do you think members of this administration don 't understand how executive privilege works, or do you think they don't care?
First, what is executive privilege? Executive privilege protects conversations where sensitive topics are discussed. A president asserts executive privilege to protect conversations that he has with his advisers, to ensure that they can give him a wide range of advice without having to worry that the confidential advice they give will one day be made public. Executive privilege has nothing to do with conversations that a president might have with a special counsel investigating a possible crime.
Thursday morning, the Biden Administration invoked executive privilege on the five hours of recordings between Biden and Special Counsel Robert Hur when they were subpoenaed by Congress - thus giving Attorney General Merrick Garland the supposed freedom to deny the request. There's one problem - the transcript for this conversation has already been released.
Biden had already ceded the privilege when he didn't assert executive privilege against handing over the transcript of the interview. The thing to protect is the record of the conversation, not the method of its recording. There is no legal distinction between the transcript and the audio recording.
When Biden failed to assert the executive privilege against releasing the transcript, he essentially declared the conversation unprotected. He cannot now assert the privilege against the release of the audio recording. His claim makes no sense. He's not trying to protect the confidentiality of the advice he gets from his counselors, he's trying to protect himself from political embarrassment.
The House Judiciary Committee and the House Oversight and Accountability Committee have voted to hold Garland in contempt of Congress for the refusal to turn the recording over to Congress. The Speaker of the House will decide if the contempt resolution is brought to the floor.

Peter, five presidents in history, including Donald Trump, captured enough Electoral College votes to win the election, but actually lost in the popular vote. In fact, in 2016, Hillary Clinton walked away with nearly 3 million more votes than Trump.
This system should trouble us all! The fate of our nation's leadership should not be left to chance or complicated electoral calculations.
Prominent elected officials, like Representative Jamie Raskin, have voiced their support for dismantling the Electoral College:
https://secure.everyaction.com/C3cGhOkjr0GV2tOFz2HXKg2?refcode=DR_EM_EN_90DO_240528_2_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&emci=3f8f1286-1ce7-ea11-8b03-00155d0394bb&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=15276917 [https://secure.everyaction.com/C3cGhOkjr0GV2tOFz2HXKg2?refcode=DR_EM_EN_90DO_240528_2_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&emci=3f8f1286-1ce7-ea11-8b03-00155d0394bb&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=15276917]
Please take 30 seconds right now to tell us before midnight: [https://secure.everyaction.com/C3cGhOkjr0GV2tOFz2HXKg2?refcode=DR_EM_EN_90DO_240528_2_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&emci=3f8f1286-1ce7-ea11-8b03-00155d0394bb&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=15276917]
Should we abolish the Electoral College?
YES [https://secure.everyaction.com/C3cGhOkjr0GV2tOFz2HXKg2?refcode=DR_EM_EN_90DO_240528_2_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&emci=3f8f1286-1ce7-ea11-8b03-00155d0394bb&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=15276917] NO [https://secure.everyaction.com/C3cGhOkjr0GV2tOFz2HXKg2?refcode=DR_EM_EN_90DO_240528_2_1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&emci=3f8f1286-1ce7-ea11-8b03-00155d0394bb&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=15276917]
The Electoral College allows minority rule, bypassing basic democratic principles. It favors white and rural areas, reducing the value of more diverse populations and minorities.
Above all, the Electoral College ensures that only a handful of swing states receive any attention during the presidential race.
One person should equal one vote.
To gauge the pulse of our community, we need 294 more responses from PA. Let your voice be heard: Should we abolish the Electoral College? subject: Help students like me hear the truth
body:
As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to “conform” to the identity that the Left created for me. | | | _Please see a special message from our sponsor. If you would like to unsubscribe, visit this[link](http://links.redconservatives.com/e/encryptedUnsubscribe?_r=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_s=0c8073304baf480d9a2fddbfd08ed4e9&_t=iYd_iovUTmpMH9lrZRZOqF1UlQTf09OVfow6FYjK8x92DQtcShR3nNFhDkRLE90hJJsu64QyXG21sBuOms8dhTpgLlIdK1NrRFg1YkDlE30%3D)_
---
[](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0c8073304baf480d9a2fddbfd08ed4e9&_e=R517LfwKlRcPJkkbL4gqjqNSGRVt_KPw7Y5WSeUU9pXyCDLB3_5bPxma8O0HkBjbATLyctrS3xy3i1w-J0iZJbL2gQtqZcxekrhWhlPmghWedL_hfba_2J75_Q-EPBYzX8Tze842PgPEFUEOgCe99Ighsa9SPZ722M343w1e355i0AqnV5nbRhIi3zkjaFF013CJHNsr96q0BdRp6QE-W2vuv19hbUoytWJ0c15u5j99QamWHoPS2rNpqnCM5--RFIHHf_QdWTMIlNVxmg16oGPUVM8SMN1zBdmSNjY4CDh3nSwVrPjiMzAi4QqbzrWahubNpQf74wye8sMYtvjzpP4KuUt4gfK_2kAuqq3pvnuIdbYJjWqQJ66LZ8D_84T4)
Fellow Patriot,

I wanted to take a moment to share something that worries me about our society.

Too many black students despise America.

Too many black students despise white people.

And many people believe that all black students should think the same way.

My name is **Jasmyn Jordan** , and I'm a student at the University of Iowa. As a young black woman, I was told that I needed to "conform" to the identity that the Left created for me.

White liberals and radical African Americans wanted me to promote Critical Race Theory and speak out about my "oppression."

But my parents didn't raise me to be a victim. My dad is a hard-working, patriotic American truck driver who listens to conservative talk radio. Often, my parents reminded me that in America we can all have our own opinions thanks to freedom of speech.

At the University of Iowa, I chose to become a committed conservative student through Young America's Foundation (YAF), the nation's leading youth outreach organization. I decided more students at the University of Iowa need to be warned about Critical Race Theory and instead hear your conservative ideas!

_The backlash from the campus Left was almost immediate._

The campus Left attacked me, calling me a "token," a bigot, a Nazi, and even a white supremacist.

Even today, they don't like seeing that there is a black female conservative who is actively participating and leading in Young America's Foundation.

But my parents raised me to have courage, so **[I proudly began to share your ideas with my fellow students through YAF](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0c8073304baf480d9a2fddbfd08ed4e9&_e=R517LfwKlRcPJkkbL4gqjqNSGRVt_KPw7Y5WSeUU9pXyCDLB3_5bPxma8O0HkBjbATLyctrS3xy3i1w-J0iZJbL2gQtqZcxekrhWhlPmghWedL_hfba_2J75_Q-EPBYzX8Tze842PgPEFUEOgCe99Ighsa9SPZ722M343w1e355i0AqnV5nbRhIi3zkjaFF013CJHNsr96q0BdRp6QE-W1TtX3-iQf-ilYi1PZTxJSu60j8rG9Ce8jKtYusGWZFvhO5c-Y7369bhtWwsyht3-_WFb8s2t0sERnFnjEoE-bG9_n-HsD7WhiS5vM5SQ5WCwqsV75uBxdGZZAW08ij_gm7E8q5GYQf8XJ--8WV9KvRYjNpUVfmUJUcbMiq36jXs)**. My fellow conservative students and I took the lead to host YAF speakers on campus, including **Matt Walsh** , Lt. Col. **Allen West** , **Vince Everett Ellison** , award-winning swimmer **Paula Scanlan** , and others.

We were determined to share your conservative ideas with as many students as possible at the University of Iowa.

I even testified before the U.S. House Judiciary Committee about the personal attacks I faced for defending free speech on campus. And I have now been appointed as the new national chairwoman for Young Americans for Freedom to oversee the largest coast-to-coast network of young conservatives! [](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0c8073304baf480d9a2fddbfd08ed4e9&_e=R517LfwKlRcPJkkbL4gqjqNSGRVt_KPw7Y5WSeUU9pXyCDLB3_5bPxma8O0HkBjbATLyctrS3xy3i1w-J0iZJbL2gQtqZcxekrhWhlPmghWedL_hfba_2J75_Q-EPBYzX8Tze842PgPEFUEOgCe99Ighsa9SPZ722M343w1e355i0AqnV5nbRhIi3zkjaFF013CJHNsr96q0BdRp6QE-WyYZ5XF0QP5ommhSgKJp_oQA90PGoq3s1FgD-zWdBUgPzUOojCUgsZdDpYs53tYD1GmnfOA-ULzvQJQNs0_MdYaPKnFXfJQDFA0fZhKQJhhjz-DR8y3ch0kmBj4sqBqo5BetOb-tRlFD_uLoK3wA_X9pTat7K8uA7PMz6DrsK315) More young people, especially young African Americans, need to hear that America is not "racist" and instead be inspired by your conservative values!

That's why each day I do everything I can to warn my fellow students of the dangers of Critical Race Theory and share your values with my peers at the University of Iowa.

And it's why I'm so passionate about Young America's Foundation-the most effective youth outreach organization recruiting the largest audiences of young people into the Conservative Movement.

Without YAF, none of my conservative activism would have been possible.

**But we can 't keep recruiting students at the University of Iowa or on college campuses nationwide without your help.** There are thousands of African-American students at the University of Iowa who need to hear the dangers and immorality of Critical Race Theory. You can help educate new, young audiences!

Specifically, we need 50 passionate conservatives to step forward before midnight with a gift of $50, so Young America's Foundation can inspire thousands more students on campuses nationwide with the truth about the values that make us great.

According to one poll, only 36% of young people ages 18 to 24 are proud of being American. But your gift right now will help change that. It changed it for me, and I know it will change it for students like me who only hear about how bad their country is instead of why they should be proud of it.

Here's where you can securely make your gift to Young America's Foundation to inspire and recruit young americans to save our country: [**https://secure.yaf.org/inspire-and-recruit-young-americans**](http://links.redconservatives.com/u/click?_t=66ce1250519441959ebe70cf27686494&_m=0c8073304baf480d9a2fddbfd08ed4e9&_e=R517LfwKlRcPJkkbL4gqjqNSGRVt_KPw7Y5WSeUU9pXyCDLB3_5bPxma8O0HkBjbATLyctrS3xy3i1w-J0iZJbL2gQtqZcxekrhWhlPmghWedL_hfba_2J75_Q-EPBYzX8Tze842PgPEFUEOgCe99Ighsa9SPZ722M343w1e355i0AqnV5nbRhIi3zkjaFF013CJHNsr96q0BdRp6QE-W13kn9C2tp-rTQWm2Wao8zIyquWAtIbVg8ZSLuBAxryJs3966sSl87oKyz4bMr8iJJb-HI96gmyhZLLs3-b_zhpwj24iPTTLXqo2f6QhtR0KO4gBgDi-8gMWn7wTUCfF-0ygSlbijLznhBBwn7kFxTU4oY9iusNSEc3hbxWqGZ3a)

I'm so grateful you are standing with us to pass on your ideas to future generations. Together we will reach more young people with the values that make America exceptional.

Gratefully,

Jasmyn Jordan
**Chairwoman, Young Americans for Freedom**
**Chairwoman, University of Iowa YAF**

Our team is working each and every day to elect Ty as our next U.S. Senator

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85754274/475788691/1023996456?refcode=RE_EM_FR_240528_logo&amount=50&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTA5NDgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYTE0NjJiY2MtZjgxYy1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=bVe1vpdM2j3YTfokqUq56i2ANMfAAzJZ2es4bTSejzY=)
Peter,

Our campaign has grassroots supporters working each and every day to make Ty our next U.S. Senator.

That work includes:

→ Talking with friends, family, and neighbors about why Ty is the candidate we need fighting for us in the U.S. Senate

→ Getting the word out about our campaign on college and university campuses

→ Recruiting other volunteers who will help us register voters and pass out campaign materials

subject: That terrible feeling
body:
Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th.

| | | | | Peter, a quick note here from me. I like to take a couple minutes to myself when I can, and reflect about why we’re doing this work. Today I was thinking back to what it felt like in 2016 when Trump won. That terrible, terrible feeling. We didn’t know exactly what would come next, but we knew it would be bad. Trump’s Supreme Court — his appointed justices — struck down Roe v. Wade. His “leadership” in the pandemic led to more than a million deaths. And his conspiracies and election denial pushed our democracy to the brink on January 6th. Do not, ever, let anyone tell you that elections do not matter. I wake up every day ready to do whatever I can to defeat Kari Lake, Trump’s “MAGA Queen.” She’s dangerous enough on her own, but if she and Trump both win in Arizona this year, we’re all in big trouble. The work we do between now and November is going to make all the difference on election day, and we have to make the most of each day. Today, I’m asking you to make a donation to my campaign. Consider it an act of hope — hope that we can continue the progress we’ve made over the last few years, and that we can stop folks like Trump and Lake from gaining any more power and influence. Can I count on you? [Split a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate and Blue Amp Action today and let’s put an end to Trump and Lake’s march back to Washington. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47f60375-b615-4851-9aeb-a1edd2232e69/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

There was a time, long before the Europeans, when the China was a seafaring nation. The Chinese had the knowledge and skill to build seaworthy vessels and the courage and seamanship to navigate them on the open oceans. They also had visionary leadership that understood the Chinese empire would secure economic and security benefits from exploring frontier domains.
These efforts peaked under the Emperor Zhu Di and [Admiral Zheng He, when, a 100 years before Columbus, Chinese treasure ships, some as long as soccer fields, sailed in fleets of hundreds, manned by thousands, to destinations as far flung as the Yemen and Africa](https://substack.com/redirect/bca61df8-c355-4923-94d0-39b454df30c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). But after the death of Zhu Di, a new emperor had other priorities and maritime trade was outlawed. Ships rotted in harbors, and knowledge and skill was lost to time. The Chinese state wouldn't return to the seas for hundreds of years, and even then only after Europeans came to the shores of the Middle Kingdom.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/771cdef9-554e-4bb5-bd40-d0d5621d6dd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I have always been struck by this story, amazed that a nation could turn its back on so obvious an achievement, failing to exploit the obvious benefits from dominating the oceans. And yet, looking back on American efforts regarding the last frontier of space, didn't we do the same thing? We are still the only nation to land a man on the moon, and yet in the decades since, American abilities (and interests?) have atrophied.
That is, until recently. The last ten years have seen an explosion of activity in space. But rather than inspiring political leaders wielding the power of state resources leading the charge, it's visionary entrepreneurs and investors who are unleashing the power of the private sector today.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/89007b1e-fc90-4914-b45f-a54fab08b875?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Earlier this year, I had the opportunity to spend time with Jim Cantrell (a founding team member of SpaceX and current Chairman and CEO of Phantom Space Corporation) and astronaut Charlie Duke (who spent three days on the moon). DISCLOSURE: I am on the Board of Directors of Phantom.
Earlier this year, a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched into space a private lunar lander designed and manufactured by Houston-based Intuitive Machines. When the lander touched down, it was the first time a private company landed on the moon, and it was America's first return to the moon since 1972.
It didn't garner much attention outside those of us who are involved in this sector, but [I wrote at the time that at some point in the near-future](https://substack.com/redirect/09a4651c-085d-485a-bcaf-81623adb5d5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we will look back and see that as a seminal moment in space industry history, like Netscape was for the Internet. That innovation opened up the potential of the World Wide Web, and an explosion of investment, growth, and commercial activity followed.
Oddly enough, the genesis of my interest in space goes back to the June 1989 massacre at Tiananmen Square. A young student at the time, I was glued to the TV, fascinated by the democratic protests that soon turned to horror. I was shocked by the brutal government crackdown upon its own people, something that gnaws at me to this day. That moment, forever etched into my mind, spurred a lifelong professional interest in China. Over the ensuing decades I have studied, written, and lectured about the rise of China and the threat it posed to the West.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6eb669f6-a6ab-427d-834a-f166679b59c5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
A few years ago, with the backdrop of a US-China rivalry that I believed was a new Cold War, I became alarmed at China's sudden focus on and progress in space. I wrote an [article](https://substack.com/redirect/34c4b16e-4041-4c4b-8856-03807eb1679d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) for the PBS NewsHour in 2016 that outlined how China became only the third nation to soft-land a spacecraft on the surface of the moon, and how that had followed its 2014 success in sending a probe around the moon (the first country to do so since the 1970's.) China, it seemed, was winning the race to space: China's capacity was growing in leaps and bounds while American efforts seemed lethargic at best...at least in terms of the public sector.
But around the same time that I was growing alarmed, the U.S. commercial space sector exploded. Rather than a competition between nation states, the new space war appears to be a battle between a totalitarian nation state and an innovative private sector. Visionary entrepreneurs and investors are leading the way, and the era of "New Space" had begun.
According to statistics from the [U.S. International Trade Commission](https://substack.com/redirect/e467648e-da51-4867-a0fa-db925d7d3c43?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), by 2022 U.S. space launches had increased by 152 percent, from 31 in 2018 to 78, finally surpassing China (64). And this surge in U.S. launch capacity was driven by the private sector; in fact, one company alone drove most of this increase: SpaceX accounted for 78 percent of all U.S. space launches in 2022, and 33 percent of all global launches.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/05383940-47c2-4238-872a-490f5720c936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
In fact, Todd Harrison of the [American Enterprise Institute](https://substack.com/redirect/8076f9a3-e479-43f1-936a-a7fb58afe1dc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) [writes](https://substack.com/redirect/ff825309-abfa-49c7-bbca-17aa05099b5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that U.S. launch capacity is now four times that of the rest of the world, and the U.S. commercial sector launched three times as many satellites as the rest of the world combined. Harrison also cites the U.S. edge in satellites. While China has increased its number of satellites since 2015 by 550% to 848, U.S. satellites have increased by 2100% in the same timeframe, to nearly 7,000. He goes on to note that 94 percent of these U.S. satellites are commercial. The U.S. has clearly regained the advantage, driven by the unleashed ingenuity and innovation of the private sector. To which I can only say...of course.
Why are we surprised? Of course, the free market system (private enterprise, competition, and access to risk capital) would yield better results. Those of us of a certain age will recall a time when this belief was in question, at least for some. The world was split between two systems, laissez-faire capitalism and centrally-planned socialism, each vying to prove its capabilities were superior.
The question, for many, was settled with the collapse of the Soviet Union, when market-driven economic organization crushed central planning in terms of production and innovation. The lesson, I believed, has been learned time and time again as evidence mounts that even the most intractable policy problems -- ranging from education to healthcare and housing to climate change - are best addressed through the application of market forces. Competition, surprise surprise, generates incentives to innovate far more efficiently than mandates from bureaucrats.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/93dae159-1af8-4055-bb36-fc598a66255c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Source: [https://nsarchive.gwu.edu/briefing-book/russia-programs/2021-12-21/end-soviet-union-1991](https://substack.com/redirect/5fe5f108-ff38-445c-a70e-ba9a4f3e153d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
New Space is also about more than just launching rockets and satellites; it has the power to create entirely new markets, heretofore unimaginable. [I've written about the creation of new industries, ranging from space manufacturing to space tourism and mining the moon](https://substack.com/redirect/09a4651c-085d-485a-bcaf-81623adb5d5c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). In fact, astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson noted as far back as 2015 that the first trillionaire will likely be the person who is able to exploit the natural resources of asteroids.
We are on the edge of an exciting new age, the prospects of which we cannot fully appreciate. Just as the Internet was the biggest development in human communication since the Gutenberg Press, space is the most important frontier since the Age of Sail opened up the oceans. Economic and security advantages hang in the balance, and just as mastery of the oceans led to the fall and rise of empires, so too will mastery of space lead to new advantages.
China turned its back on exploration because it was a closed society and everything depended on the priorities of the emperor and coterie of bureaucrats who made up his court. The genius of America is that we live in an open society, a churning mix of ideas and innovations. And even though our political class long-ago lost interest in space, the private sector has forced it to the forefront once again, revealed the possibilities, and captivated the nation's imagination. Unlike the Chinese of centuries ago, America now has the chance to reverse its mistake and return to the mastery of the next frontier, one that offers untold potential to change life on Earth and create possibilities for a multi planetary existence.

Can the private sector outcompete nation states in the battle to dominate the next frontier? | | | May 28 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- There was a time, long before the Europeans, when the China was a seafaring nation. The Chinese had the knowledge and skill to build seaworthy vessels and the courage and seamanship to navigate them on the open oceans. They also had visionary leadership that understood the Chinese empire would secure economic and security benefits from exploring frontier domains. These efforts peaked under the Emperor Zhu Di and . But after the death of Zhu Di, a new emperor had other priorities and maritime trade was outlawed. Ships rotted in harbors, and knowledge and skill was lost to time. The Chinese state wouldn't return to the seas for hundreds of years, and even then only after Europeans came to the shores of the Middle Kingdom. I have always been struck by this story, amazed that a nation could turn its back on so obvious an achievement, failing to exploit the obvious benefits from dominating the oceans. And yet, looking back on American efforts regarding the last frontier of space, didn't we do the same thing? We are still the only nation to land a man on the moon, and yet in the decades since, American abilities (and interests?) have atrophied. That is, until recently. The last ten years have seen an explosion of activity in space. But rather than inspiring political leaders wielding the power of state resources leading the charge, it's visionary entrepreneurs and investors who are unleashing the power of the private sector today. | | ---|---|--- Earlier this year, I had the opportunity to spend time with Jim Cantrell (a founding team member of SpaceX and current Chairman and CEO of Phantom Space Corporation) and astronaut Charlie Duke (who spent three days on the moon). DISCLOSURE: I am on the Board of Directors of Phantom. Earlier this year, a SpaceX Falcon 9 rocket launched into space a private lunar lander designed and manufactured by Houston-based Intuitive Machines. When the lander touched down, it was the first time a private company landed on the moon, and it was America's first return to the moon since 1972. It didn't garner much attention outside those of us who are involved in this sector, but , we will look back and see that as a seminal moment in space industry history, like Netscape was for the Internet. That innovation opened up the potential of the World Wide Web, and an explosion of investment, growth, and commercial activity followed. Oddly enough, the genesis of my interest in space goes back to the June 1989 massacre at Tiananmen Square. A young student at the time, I was glued to the TV, fascinated by the democratic protests that soon turned to horror. I was shocked by the brutal government crackdown upon its own people, something that gnaws at me to this day. That moment, forever etched into my mind, spurred a lifelong professional interest in China. Over the ensuing decades I have studied, written, and lectured about the rise of China and the threat it posed to the West. A few years ago, with the backdrop of a US-China rivalry that I believed was a new Cold War, I became alarmed at China's sudden focus on and progress in space. I wrote an for the PBS NewsHour in 2016 that outlined how China became only the third nation to soft-land a spacecraft on the surface of the moon, and how that had followed its 2014 success in sending a probe around the moon (the first country to do so since the 1970's.) China, it seemed, was winning the race to space: China's capacity was growing in leaps and bounds while American efforts seemed lethargic at best...at least in terms of the public sector. But around the same time that I was growing alarmed, the U.S. commercial space sector exploded. Rather than a competition between nation states, the new space war appears to be a battle between a totalitarian nation state and an innovative private sector. Visionary entrepreneurs and investors are leading the way, and the era of "New Space" had begun. According to statistics from the , by 2022 U.S. space launches had increased by 152 percent, from 31 in 2018 to 78, finally surpassing China (64). And this surge in U.S. launch capacity was driven by the private sector; in fact, one company alone drove most of this increase: SpaceX accounted for 78 percent of all U.S. space launches in 2022, and 33 percent of all global launches. In fact, Todd Harrison of the that U.S. launch capacity is now four times that of the rest of the world, and the U.S. commercial sector launched three times as many satellites as the rest of the world combined. Harrison also cites the U.S. edge in satellites. While China has increased its number of satellites since 2015 by 550% to 848, U.S. satellites have increased by 2100% in the same timeframe, to nearly 7,000. He goes on to note that 94 percent of these U.S. satellites are commercial. The U.S. has clearly regained the advantage, driven by the unleashed ingenuity and innovation of the private sector. To which I can only say...of course. Why are we surprised? Of course, the free market system (private enterprise, competition, and access to risk capital) would yield better results. Those of us of a certain age will recall a time when this belief was in question, at least for some. The world was split between two systems, laissez-faire capitalism and centrally-planned socialism, each vying to prove its capabilities were superior. The question, for many, was settled with the collapse of the Soviet Union, when market-driven economic organization crushed central planning in terms of production and innovation. The lesson, I believed, has been learned time and time again as evidence mounts that even the most intractable policy problems -- ranging from education to healthcare and housing to climate change - are best addressed through the application of market forces. Competition, surprise surprise, generates incentives to innovate far more efficiently than mandates from bureaucrats. | | ---|---|--- Source: New Space is also about more than just launching rockets and satellites; it has the power to create entirely new markets, heretofore unimaginable. . In fact, astrophysicist Neil deGrasse Tyson noted as far back as 2015 that the first trillionaire will likely be the person who is able to exploit the natural resources of asteroids. We are on the edge of an exciting new age, the prospects of which we cannot fully appreciate. Just as the Internet was the biggest development in human communication since the Gutenberg Press, space is the most important frontier since the Age of Sail opened up the oceans. Economic and security advantages hang in the balance, and just as mastery of the oceans led to the fall and rise of empires, so too will mastery of space lead to new advantages. China turned its back on exploration because it was a closed society and everything depended on the priorities of the emperor and coterie of bureaucrats who made up his court. The genius of America is that we live in an open society, a churning mix of ideas and innovations. And even though our political class long-ago lost interest in space, the private sector has forced it to the forefront once again, revealed the possibilities, and captivated the nation's imagination. Unlike the Chinese of centuries ago, America now has the chance to reverse its mistake and return to the mastery of the next frontier, one that offers untold potential to change life on Earth and create possibilities for a multi planetary existence. | | ---|---|--- VIKRAM MANSHARAMANI is an entrepreneur, consultant, scholar, neighbor, husband, father, volunteer, and professional generalist who thinks in multiple-dimensions and looks beyond the short-term. | Peter, As someone deeply invested in the future of our community and our nation, I am excited to invite you to an important Listen & Learn event tomorrow, where Bill will tackle the critical issue of illegal immigration in New Jersey.
---
|
---
**The session is happening tomorrow evening, Wednesday, May 29, from 6:30 PM to 7:30 PM at Elks Lodge 815, 1 Kane Pl, East Hanover, NJ.
** **Pizza and refreshments will be served.** The situation at the border is more than a political debate; it's a burgeoning crisis affecting communities across America, including ours here in New Jersey.
---
| Recently, I visited the Texas-Mexico border with Bill, an experience that starkly revealed the extensive challenges we face—a situation that echoes strongly back to our state. What we're dealing with at our border is more than a crisis; it's a full-blown invasion.

---
|
---
| Tomorrow's session will focus on:
* **Exposing the Invasion:** Bill will uncover how illegal immigration is not just impacting, but overwhelming New Jersey, threatening the fabric of our communities.
* **Strategic Defense:** We'll talk about how to forge effective and immediate actions to safeguard our state, ensuring practical solutions that restore order and uphold our laws.
* **Frontline Insights:** Bill will share compelling firsthand observations from our recent border visit, illuminating the dire national crisis and its ramifications for our state.

**This is more than just a conversation; it’s about taking action and making informed decisions to secure a safe and prosperous future for New Jersey.** Your voice is crucial in this discussion. Join us as we explore actionable steps and strategies to tackle one of the most pressing issues facing our community today. See you there, Elizabeth Nader

Many observe politicians who, regardless of party affiliation, appear more interested in self-preservation than serving the American people. We've all seen elected officials campaign on promises they swiftly abandon once in office.
