"Why are you a Republican?" It's a question I often encounter, especially in today's political climate where our elected officials seem to have no core beliefs or values. Many observe politicians who, regardless of party affiliation, appear more interested in self-preservation than serving the American people. We've all seen elected officials campaign on promises they swiftly abandon once in office.
The division in our nation seems to be getting larger, protest are becoming more violent, debate ends in argument, and unity as a nation seems to be lost. As we watch the division grow, some believe that if our political leaders could just set aside their differences we'd all benefit. We just want everyone to get-along. However, I believe this perspective is misguided. Let me explain why.
Contrary to popular belief, our government officials aren't divided. While politicians publicly fight along party lines, behind closed doors, their primary objective remains constant: re-election. Many elected Democrats and Republicans share this fundamental goal, which often leads them to agreements that only secure their positions of power even if it's bad for our country.
If our politicians were truly divided on matters of ideology and policy, this division would yield better outcomes for the American people. Vigorous debate about how to make our nation better is good and when both parties share the common goal of improving the lives of the people then that debate produces good policy. But, when politicians who have no foundation of ideology create division among the people to enhance their power, the people lose.
At the Tippah County Republican Party, we stand for the core principles upon which our party was founded, not for the sake of party allegiance or our own personal gain. Recently, representatives from Tippah County reaffirmed our commitment to these principles at the Republican Party State Convention. Our mission statement below and Party Platform outline these principles, guiding our actions and decisions.
_**Mission of the Tippah County Republican Party:**_
_The mission of the Tippah County Republican Party is to promote and uphold conservative values and principles within our community. We are dedicated to preserving the constitutional rights of all citizens, advocating for limited government, fiscal responsibility, and individual freedom. We strive to foster an environment where the American Dream is attainable for all, through free enterprise, personal responsibility, and equal opportunity. We are committed to engaging with our community, listening to their concerns, and working together to find solutions that reflect our shared values. Together, we will work to build a stronger, more prosperous, and more united community._
_[Click Here to read the party platform](https://substack.com/redirect/0b813865-7276-4bae-80fd-cd9bb76e08ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_
If these values resonate with you, I encourage you to engage with your government. You can start by subscribing to email updates at [www.TippahGOP.org](https://substack.com/redirect/956f28ef-00c1-4e95-9954-610e0660dc89?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). subject: Texas Republicans just adopted a new platform
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

Texas Republicans just adopted a new platform at their state convention
that pushes their radical, anti-democracy agenda to new extremes.
(Remember, these are the guys who decided to remove this clause from their
platform last year: "The Republican Party of Texas will have no
association whatsoever with any individual or organization that is known
to espouse anti-Semitism, pro-Nazi sympathies, or Holocaust denial.")

If enacted through legislation, as their members have committed to do,
their new plan will require the Bible to be taught in public schools and
will fuel new attacks on reproductive healthcare and the LGBTQ community.

But perhaps most alarmingly, the Texas GOP platform calls for new laws
that will no longer allow the winner of the popular vote in Texas to hold
office if they don’t also win a majority of Texas counties.

Republicans clearly understand that it is only a matter of time before
Democrats win statewide. And they are trying to change the rules of our
elections before that can happen.

Their anxiety is reflected by the trajectory of change in Texas. Barack
Obama lost the state by 16 points in 2012. Four years later, Hillary
Clinton lost by 9. In 2020, Joe Biden lost Texas by a little more than 5
percent. Texas is turning blue faster than any other battleground state in
the country.

Realizing the inevitable, Republicans have done everything they can to
entrench themselves in power by reducing voting rights, including:
racially gerrymandering the state, closing hundreds of polling places,
imposing the harshest voter ID law in the country and targeting Harris
County for the most intense suppression and intimidation campaign in the
country. This is in a state that already lacks online voter registration,
same-day voter registration or automatic voter registration.

In fact, they’ve made Texas the toughest state in the nation in which to
vote or to register to vote.

But they fear that even these extreme measures won’t be enough to stop
Democrats from winning, so they’re taking the extraordinary step of trying

name: Candace Owens, BLEXIT
subject: They want to defund the police
body:
Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend,

I am so grateful for our police officers.

As an American who believes in law and order,
truth, and justice, I have always stood with the public servants
who protect our communities.

Please join me in thanking uniformed men and women
by signing our 'Back the Blue Petition' and letting brave
officers know that we are grateful for their service and
sacrifice.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Unfortunately, a few years ago, radicals began
propelling criminals into heroes overnight and campaigning to
"defund the police."

I refuse to accept that we must cater to the bottom
denominator of our society and that the black community must
fight and scream and demand support for the people in our
community who are up to no good.

That's one of the reasons I founded BLEXIT - an
organization focused on shifting the culture in Black America as
well as educating and uplifting minorities through educational
programs and acts of community service.

Around the nation, our BLEXIT chapters have
supported local officers, while so many others have turned their
backs on those who serve our communities.

To join these chapters and stand with police
officers, please sign the national petition today.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

This summer, BLEXIT Maryland spent the day giving
back to the Baltimore Police Department and learned some history
about the city's police force.

The first state chapter - BLEXIT North Carolina -
paid a visit to local officers in July. Our State Director
showered them with thank-you notes and delicious food as a token
of BLEXIT's appreciation.

If you 'Back the Blue' - and believe that we must
support local heroes - please sign the national petition right
away.

While the 'defund the police' crowd wants us to
think minorities stand with them - polls show that the vast
majority of black voters (more than 80%) want police funding to
stay the same or even increase.

We've been sold a lot of lies by anti-police
radicals - those lies have been a detriment to Black American
culture, the country as a whole, and the police officers who
fight for justice every day.

We must stop the deception that is harming urban
communities and demeaning police around the nation.

If you are an American, no matter what color you
are, you should want law and you should want order. That is the
way forward.

Join me in letting our police officers know that
you support law and order, justice, and their valiant efforts to
keep our communities safe.

Sign the 'Back the Blue Petition'

Candace Owens

Chair of BLEXIT

body:
I'm thrilled to be the official Republican candidate for Senate in California

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z6f69c543lj7bgdps97dq0e1fjqdjnlqst9hmkhg_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjh61oj2clh2bs)

| | Dear Friend, I'm thrilled to be the official Republican candidate for Senate in California, and I owe much of my success so far to grassroots donors like you. Our average online donation is $41.65, but [**today I'm reaching out for a special contribution of $6.**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zbj4h6uco8275kds8903hrt4j4a02f4ecu4tmac0_rp22sh2s8i6ep33cjh61oj2clh2bs) The number 6 holds a special significance for me—it was the number on my jersey every time I took the field to represent Californians during my time with the Dodgers and the Padres. As anti-abortion extremists devise new tactics to scare, intimidate, and confuse people—we are fighting back, and we need you with us. If you agree that abortion is essential—and I know you do—please help fuel this fight with a generous gift. | "MATCH MY GIFT" Your impact, already undeniable and crucial, will go 3X as far. What does that translate to? Just take a look at the latest news and updates from our work: Center works to secure right to abortion in Florida's constitution Earlier this month, Florida's six-week abortion ban went into effect, leaving abortion severely restricted or totally banned in every southeastern state in the U.S. We are working with partners on the ground to secure a right to abortion in the state’s constitution through a ballot measure that will go to FL voters this fall. The fight to end the U.S. maternal health crisis continues The maternal health crisis is terrifying and unjust—but it is also solvable. With your support, the Center is spearheading initiatives to expand postpartum Medicaid, defending midwifery care, and fighting for policy reform at all levels to improve maternal health and outcomes. Center challenging Honduras's total abortion ban** The Center is challenging Honduras's total abortion ban on behalf of our client, Fausia. Fausia is an indigenous woman and human rights defender belonging to the Nahua People who was raped in retaliation for her work as a defender of her land. Because she didn't have access to abortion under Honduras's total ban, she became pregnant and was forced to give birth against her will. We are fighting for Fausia, her family, and those who have been forced into motherhood as a result of Honduras's ban on abortion. Please, don't wait to take advantage of our special match opportunity. Thank you. I'm proud to have you on our team. Nancy Northup President & CEO P.S. I don’t need to tell you that this election is a big one for our democracy. But what you may not know is that one of the most important fights will be the one **to secure fair maps.** Redistricting — with politicians often redrawing electoral maps to try and give their party an advantage — affects every part of our democracy. And it’s happening constantly. If we don’t do the work today to make maps more fair, gerrymandered maps will continue to drown out the will of the people for years to come. **That’s why the NDRC has a plan to target the most important races in key states in the fight for fair maps. But that work can get overshadowed without supporters like you stepping up.[So can you help fund our efforts to strengthen democracy across the country this year?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85775403/475853347/2035465197?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_mayfun_email_20240528-NDRC-Red-ObamaMay_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240528-NDRC-Red-ObamaMay_&utm_campaign=mayfun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI1ZmY3ZGQ3LTE1MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Wk1DfaWxWHKUiM_2LZAy3S50Xx71i7Nnx8d8ajTNWf4=)** Anti-democratic forces don’t try to bend the maps in their favor just for fun. They do it so they can continue to drive their extreme, unpopular agenda. And that can lead to majorities that don’t represent the will of the people taking away things like affordable health care, reproductive freedom, and even basic civil rights. I know that the race for the White House gets most of the attention in a year like this — and it certainly is crucial. But it’s also important for people like you to keep your eye on the long game. **Because if we all do our part and get involved in this fight, we can make our democracy stronger and more resilient.** [**Will you make a donation and join me in the fight to make elections fairer and defend our democracy?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85775404/475853350/2035465197?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_mayfun_email_20240528-NDRC-Red-ObamaMay_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240528-NDRC-Red-ObamaMay_&utm_campaign=mayfun&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImI1ZmY3ZGQ3LTE1MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=Wk1DfaWxWHKUiM_2LZAy3S50Xx71i7Nnx8d8ajTNWf4=) Your dedication to this cause does not go unnoticed. body:
Taking on the fossil fuel industry starts on the ground.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85776244/475856557/1328794144?refcode=ea.4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQzMjRlZWI5LTE3MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BU_PJ0g5s2CBnyBie8jlIKJnSgIqyrXn6nSKLqT706E=&emci=787949d3-041a-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=4823105)
---
Hey climate champion, **At Jane PAC we know the most successful movements are built from the ground up,** not the top down. That’s why we’re pouring so much time, effort, and resources into expanding our grassroots organizing efforts, and we’re excited to share some of our strategy with you. Real change doesn’t come from a slick TV ad; it happens when neighbors talk to neighbors, and when friends mobilize their friend group. **In the weeks and months to come, we are building a volunteer-led voter contact field program that will drive turnout in the races that will have an outsized impact on climate policy.** We are going to be recruiting volunteers, identifying pro-climate voters, canvassing, phonebanking, postcarding, distributing yard signs, hosting meetings, throwing rallies, and more. We need the pro-climate vote to be loud, visible, and organized. But we need a lot of financial support to build the robust grassroots movement we need. We’re confident that members of this community are willing to generously contribute their time to a meaningful cause. In order to honor that commitment and maximize the impact of their work, we need to invest significant resources up front to get started — like the software we need to access the voter databases in our targeted districts, additional staff capacity, canvassing & phone banking tools, and more. **We don’t take your support lightly.** Our donors are crucial members of our team, and we want to show you exactly what your money is funding. We look forward to keeping you posted on our progress. **[Look, we can’t do this without you. If you are able, please rush a donation now so we can get this project off the ground >>>](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85776245/475856558/2105508926?refcode=ea.4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQzMjRlZWI5LTE3MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BU_PJ0g5s2CBnyBie8jlIKJnSgIqyrXn6nSKLqT706E=)** | [**DONATE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85776246/475856586/2105508926?refcode=ea.4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ms=ea.4324eeb9-171d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjQzMjRlZWI5LTE3MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=BU_PJ0g5s2CBnyBie8jlIKJnSgIqyrXn6nSKLqT706E=)
---
**This is a multi-phased campaign,** and we need to get started as soon as possible. We are identifying and talking to voters about our climate champions, and then getting them out to vote before polls close on Election Day. It sounds simple and straightforward, and in many ways it is, but it is a lot of work that will require significant people-hours between now and Election Day.
Looking forward to out-organizing and out-voting the fossil fuel industry with you! Keep an eye on your inbox. We’ll be sharing more information about how you can get involved very soon.

clean_body: Taking on the fossil fuel industry starts on the ground. | Hey climate champion, At Jane PAC we know the most successful movements are built from the ground up, not the top down. That’s why we’re pouring so much time, effort, and resources into expanding our grassroots organizing efforts, and we’re excited to share some of our strategy with you. Real change doesn’t come from a slick TV ad; it happens when neighbors talk to neighbors, and when friends mobilize their friend group. In the weeks and months to come, we are building a volunteer-led voter contact field program that will drive turnout in the races that will have an outsized impact on climate policy. We are going to be recruiting volunteers, identifying pro-climate voters, canvassing, phonebanking, postcarding, distributing yard signs, hosting meetings, throwing rallies, and more. We need the pro-climate vote to be loud, visible, and organized. But we need a lot of financial support to build the robust grassroots movement we need. We’re confident that members of this community are willing to generously contribute their time to a meaningful cause. In order to honor that commitment and maximize the impact of their work, we need to invest significant resources up front to get started — like the software we need to access the voter databases in our targeted districts, additional staff capacity, canvassing & phone banking tools, and more. We don’t take your support lightly. Our donors are crucial members of our team, and we want to show you exactly what your money is funding. We look forward to keeping you posted on our progress. = | = This is a multi-phased campaign, and we need to get started as soon as possible. We are identifying and talking to voters about our climate champions, and then getting them out to vote before polls close on Election Day. It sounds simple and straightforward, and in many ways it is, but it is a lot of work that will require significant people-hours between now and Election Day. Looking forward to out-organizing and out-voting the fossil fuel industry with you! Keep an eye on your inbox. We’ll be sharing more information about how you can get involved very soon. Solidarity, The Jane PAC Organizing Team | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. Mike Rogers: 36.8%
Undecided: 23.3% Polling is a notoriously fickle science, especially since it's still early, but this data underscores a fundamental truth: Michigan is a swing state, and swing states have a tendency to...swing. Despite Democrats' success in recent years, we know it can flip under the right conditions.

So in light of this new poll, I want to ask if you'll consider making a $3 contribution to my campaign.

$3, because we are in a statistical tie against a Trump-endorsed candidate.

$3, because Democrats only have a 51 seat majority in the U.S. Senate, and with Joe Manchin's retirement and a likely flip in West Virginia, we need to hold onto this seat for Democrats to retain control of the body.

$3, because our race is the top of the ticket in Michigan — which means what happens will likely have an impact on the presidential race here as well.

$3, because more than one in five voters are undecided in our race, and we need to be able to talk to those voters in all 11 of Michigan's media markets.

I wouldn't ask if it weren't important, but there are less than six months left until Election Day and contributions from people like you in response to emails like this represent the bulk of the money we raise — which means your support is critical to getting us over the finish line.

subject: The Mountain Minute: 5/28/2024
body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, May 28, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Initiatives to open primaries, bring ranked choice voting challenged in Colorado Supreme Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
DENVER -- While two ballot initiatives dealing with [Ranked Choice Voting (RCV)](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) are already either gathering signatures or in the petition approval phase with the secretary of state, two more citizen-initiated measures that would completely upend Colorado elections are going through an appeals process with the Colorado Supreme Court.
Ballot initiatives [188](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and [310](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) "Concerning the Conduct of Elections," would drastically change the way primary elections are held in Colorado.
Only one of the two initiatives would actually go to voters, as they are near mirror images of each other, but either one would make Colorado's primaries fully open and mandate use of RCV to conduct the elections.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Remembering those'that gave all': Colorado Freedom Memorial in Aurora honors fallen servicemen](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVER GAZETTE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Freedom Memorial Foundation and the City of Aurora held their [11th annual "Colorado Remembers" ceremony](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to honor fallen servicemen and servicewomen, featuring a 1,000-pound bronze bell and cannon fire as key elements of the event.
* Rick Crandall, the executive director of the [Colorado Freedom Memorial Foundation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), emphasized the importance of remembering the fallen and their families, highlighting a glass monument with the names of 6,218 military members from Colorado.
* A [piece of the USS Arizona](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a battleship destroyed during the attack on Pearl Harbor, was presented to the Colorado Freedom Memorial, enhancing the site's historical significance.
* [Future plans for the park](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) include the construction of a visitor center with a theater and conference rooms, designed to deepen visitors' understanding of each individual honored at the memorial.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Colorado vets go through hundreds of unclaimed cremated remains to give comrades dignified memorial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver's Vietnam Veterans of America Chapter 1071 provided full military honors and a dignified burial to [13 unclaimed cremains of U.S. military veterans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) at Fort Logan National Cemetery, part of an ongoing initiative that has honored 143 veterans since 2016.
* Volunteers, including state records custodians and college students, collaborate to identify unclaimed cremains of veterans across Colorado, [creating personalized ceremonies](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) with custom-crafted wooden boxes and full military honors.
* The project aims to address a national issue where [over 100,000 veterans' cremains have gone unclaimed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), embodying the commitment to ensure no veteran is forgotten, in line with the Vietnam Veterans of America's motto: "Never again will one generation of veterans abandon another."
* [Challenges persist](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in accessing information from smaller funeral homes and locating additional unclaimed cremains, but dedicated volunteers and organizers continue to drive the project forward, honoring those who served.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Libertarians pick Chase Oliver as presidential nominee, rejecting RFK, Jr., and Trump](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [POLITICO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Libertarian Party selected [Chase Oliver](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), a former Georgia Senate candidate, as their presidential nominee during their national convention, rejecting high-profile figures such as Donald Trump and Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
* Donald Trump, who suggested he would be the best nominee for the Libertarian Party, was booed and [declared ineligible by the party's chair](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Robert F. Kennedy Jr. was eliminated in the first round of voting.
* Party members expressed [concerns that Kennedy's candidacy could significantly damage the Libertarian Party's standing](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), fearing a loss of ballot access in numerous states due to reduced vote share.
* As the presidential nominee, Oliver aims to [target young voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on issues like the Israel-Hamas war, immigration, and cost of living, leveraging social media platforms like Twitch and TikTok to reach this demographic.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Congress preps for drama with spending, farm bill, Pentagon policy and election-year bombast](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [THE WASHINGTON TIMES](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* In an election-year, Congress is focusing on [critical legislation](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) such as spending bills, the farm bill, and Pentagon policy, amidst partisan divisions.
* Senate Democrats are pushing symbolic votes on issues like contraception rights, while House Republicans aim to [pass conservative-oriented bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to strengthen their negotiation leverage.
* Internal GOP conflicts and centrists' resistance to conservative proposals, such as abortion-related restrictions, pose challenges to passing all [12 annual spending bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The [farm bill is contentious](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), particularly over cuts to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) and agricultural climate initiatives, requiring bipartisan support for passage.
* Both parties seek bipartisan cooperation on a bill to [sanction the International Criminal Court](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in response to its actions against Israeli officials, prioritizing legislative effectiveness over partisan messaging.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Bills Signed By Governor Polis This Week](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY RMV STAFF** **| STATE | MAY 26** _Colorado Governor Jared Polis has been active in signing multiple bills into law, including one aimed at implementing comprehensive guidelines for funeral facilities.___
**[Moriarty: Democrats' Colorado Energy story has a bad ending](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY TOM MORIARTY****| COMMENTARY | MAY 26** _Colorado Governor Jared Polis and the Colorado democrats tell us a story about fossil fuels. This story has three parts: fossil fuels are bad, the democrats have a plan to eliminate fossil fuels, and their plan is working._
**[Applegate: Possible solutions for El Paso County's immigration problem](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY CORY APPLEGATE****| COMMENTARY | MAY 24** _El Paso County recently saw two busloads of immigrants here illegally come down from Denver. Since Denver 's sanctuary city policies create their own fiscal burden, they now claim they cannot afford to keep taking care of lawbreakers they attracted in the first place. The hospitals in the Denver area gave away $136 million in care last year, which will never be paid back by those with no income or insurance._

|
---
**🤔 DID YOU KNOW?** Ever wonder the meaning behind **Colorado's state flag**?

The blue outer stripes on are meant to represent Colorado's beautiful blue skies. The middle white stripe represents the snowcapped Rocky Mountains. The red of the C in the center represents the red dirt found throughout the state. Filling the open space inside the letter "C" is a golden disk. This gold circle represents the hundreds of days of yearly sunshine enjoyed on average by the state.

body:
That’s all I’m asking, Peter
# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1252%2E62735%2Eh1WQny)
| | | Peter, **We’re exactly ten weeks away from primary day in Michigan**. This is our opportunity to reject six more years of the same failed, out-of-touch, establishment “leadership” in Washington. When I look at Michigan today, I see single moms working two jobs just to make ends meet. I see working families choosing between groceries and health insurance. I see folks filing for bankruptcy because of sky-high medical debt, all while Big Pharma rakes in record profits. This isn’t the American dream — it's the product of career politicians putting power over the people. That’s why I turned down $20 million from one of AIPAC’s biggest donors to run a grassroots, people-powered campaign.**Our broken system allows the rich and powerful to buy the election results THEY want, and, Peter****— it’s time to bring the system down.** [**So, with 10 weeks to go until the Michigan Senate primary, will you chip in just $10 to reject the status quo and WIN this high-stakes race for our future?**](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1572?t=2&akid=1252%2E62735%2Eh1WQny) You don’t have to run for office to know that the system is rigged towards the wealthy and well-connected, or that our leaders in Washington are totally out of touch with the problems on the ground. **That’s why rejecting the establishment is key to unlocking Michigan’s true potential. ** On August 6th, we have a chance to buck the establishment and build a real progressive future in Michigan. We have a chance to end the Senate filibuster and pass historic reforms, from delivering universal healthcare to raising the federal minimum wage. We have a chance to get money out of politics and _finally_ put Washington back to work for the people. **But we can’t bring this system down if we don’t out-hustle our opponent every single day between now and the election. ** So here’s the deal: My opponent had a head start in this race and is backed by the Washington establishment. As a political outsider, I’m at a serious disadvantage — no buts about it. But the sooner we can deploy our campaign’s resources and reach more voters, the sooner we can take the lead in these next five months and _win._ **And since I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, my campaign needs**** _every_****dollar we can get right now.** This is our moment, and we need to seize it Peter . | **Ashley 🚁:** Hey Janelle, how's it going with defeating Scott Perry in PA-10? **Janelle 📺:** Ashley, I can't believe this guy still has a job! He voted against lowering prescription drug prices, voted to defund the FBI, wants a nationwide abortion ban with no exceptions and is the only member of the Pennsylvania Congressional delegation to oppose giving a medal to the police officers who defended the Capitol on Jan. 6. He even had his cell phone confiscated as he was investigated for his involvement. How are things going in PA-01 with Brian Fitzpatrick? **Ashley 🚁:** This guy is SUCH a MAGA pushover! He refused to hold anyone accountable for Jan. 6, and constantly sides with them on everything from abortion to gun safety. No wonder Matt Gaetz and MTG get away with causing so much chaos – Fitzpatrick has no backbone to stand up to them! But being a MAGA pushover has paid off. They love giving him $$$. **Janelle 📺:** Right! As a 6-term incumbent, Congressman Perry certainly has a dark money advantage. My grassroots supporters are amazing, but it is going to take a lot of money to defeat Perry in November. **Ashley 🚁:** Same here – I got in this race to protect the people of PA-01. Turns out, that means raising a lot of money for the campaign 😅 Here's an idea... what if we asked our supporters to help out BOTH of our campaigns? Make sure we flip PA-01 and PA-10 blue in November? **Janelle 📺:** Love this! Especially with our big end-of-month deadline coming up? Let's do it. | | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=400489336f7045a293fbd877b18bdff2&_e=TZ7qkA3Bv5b6WHouE3pdLqdQQWcwNeYZlCZyps8xy-s4pnJjcv1DpfUBYPPbsNIu3cK5XQ5Su-FBu6xBEPpMGRFv3SPsnfA8IEWBamcv4rpdskLlaH6_fMViwMN411yQv6Ur96wlnrolWMXTyaHptAdo04po3a_KoAzudJPC2XVbbkfmKyME0HPZlw21iMrAxje1dE9wpJcaFAsTlCtzAIRZADqN4fF82wN1HnffuUHOOLJ1gKCfWvT1boFxG-Z5uik6jCAcCqEgbIDvZmaqaC3v-1Kt5ICFiygAwwebdPZr8ltvr43ovwWTpYzx8fnIozCA29cslXoHma9GQJkWULgGSo8XoDMcopQN-1ZXSbcg4hq0Znpphxe5qe12q5OOSaVVXuPlIbBmIwXLvkpvJw%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.thegopreport.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=400489336f7045a293fbd877b18bdff2&_e=TZ7qkA3Bv5b6WHouE3pdLqdQQWcwNeYZlCZyps8xy-s4pnJjcv1DpfUBYPPbsNIu3cK5XQ5Su-FBu6xBEPpMGRFv3SPsnfA8IEWBamcv4rpdskLlaH6_fMViwMN411yQv6Ur96wlnrolWMXTyaHptAdo04po3a_KoAzudJPC2XVbbkfmKyME0HPZlw21iMrAxje1dE9wpJcaFAsTlCtzAIRZADqN4fF82wN1HnffuUF5bmaLfOC6X7UcGC5ePwbgWNviLqdK5BeJcyXzBpDrrdS0NHulIinUz5d0kl_kEGD8a6zVJ1TOO8VKVZzDU4ZUP_LqoBaIHRmTAmNKhfnk25PwcR82hD-dMWpo7WGsyJGmo_Cbn1zjcovhZHE0Bj3ZiQpfjaGUZNnDzy0XrKpSKg%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Peter,
Growing up in Orange County, my family instilled in me a deep sense of duty toward public service and community welfare. In fact, I come from a long line of first responders and military veterans, and I am a second-generation Fire Captain for the Orange County Fire Authority.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=X_052824_firefighters [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftjoekerr?refcode=X_052824_firefighters]
For 34 years, I had the honor of responding to nearly every significant disaster our Southern California faced. In those moments of crisis, I witnessed the strength and resilience of our community. I saw neighbors coming together to support one another, and I learned firsthand the importance of leadership and collaboration in times of adversity.

clean_body: [] Peter, Growing up in Orange County, my family instilled in me a deep sense of duty toward public service and community welfare. In fact, I come from a long line of first responders and military veterans, and I am a second-generation Fire Captain for the Orange County Fire Authority. [] For 34 years, I had the honor of responding to nearly every significant disaster our Southern California faced. In those moments of crisis, I witnessed the strength and resilience of our community. I saw neighbors coming together to support one another, and I learned firsthand the importance of leadership and collaboration in times of adversity. [] [] It is these lessons that I carry with me as I embark on a new journey – seeking to represent the people of the 40th District in Congress. So, friend, can I count on you to donate to my campaign today? Politicians like Young Kim are only adding fuel to the fire, and I know how to put those out. Fellow Conservative,

I won’t beat around the bush today—I need your financial support. My primary is one week from today, and we’re running dangerously low on critical campaign dollars we need to reach voters over the next seven days.

_**Not only are we running low on campaign funds less than six months before the general election, but we’re being outraised 3-1, sometimes even 5-1.**_

As I’ve written before, this election will be the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history on a per-vote basis.

In our morning check-in, my finance director informed me that _**we need to raise at least $10,000 from this email today to avoid running out of funds between now and next week's primary.**_**[link to donate](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=42e444882b2e44dcba1868ed23e83c9e&_e=KT5G82Ax3C57ISm35TijQP76fIq06YKDZ3-THi1N452IvS8Dd-1wyr_0yjIjGvNHurTwQTiWfZnqh2U5xFhLsDnggrbTeHm_SCGIObSpz3YtQj8xyVVtWvzpaWX_exzVIEefG170aoaE56cOJdeUwbJkED7e31vq3g5wz4j9kYv6dAc-vUmrU_kz2VBiL8TwWkllTicObaHnQ4xf21MlYp4EosJ9wGo1f_-4OAnnjpgUITNeQEXpQg10H7IBrKC96cPU5dHoVoFxaLKr3NzcdRgW_VU7WCGpbyKYNtp3DeRqkdoXN7dafQspO5UE3uYT4FoMh7MzId5oh8GvskBxRKAtZ3xD9gQHduiCXaG0jJ_xKcnEQ01SvN9TXp7mITtWH2yfKY0_on-UNmWQZ2IOEiu7NmReG3KDVQbGj2KS6nQ%3D)->**

I realize you have several political candidates and causes soliciting you for support, so **[I would be incredibly grateful if you considered donating your hard-earned money to my U.S. Senate campaign today.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=42e444882b2e44dcba1868ed23e83c9e&_e=KT5G82Ax3C57ISm35TijQP76fIq06YKDZ3-THi1N452IvS8Dd-1wyr_0yjIjGvNHurTwQTiWfZnqh2U5xFhLsDnggrbTeHm_SCGIObSpz3YtQj8xyVVtWvzpaWX_exzVIEefG170aoaE56cOJdeUwbJkED7e31vq3g5wz4j9kYv6dAc-vUmrU_kz2VBiL8TwWkllTicObaHnQ4xf21MlYp4EosJ9wGo1f_-4OAnnjpgUITNeQEXpQg10H7IBrKC96cPU5dHoVoFxaLKr3NzcdYnz1gDcVrrsj80R7ERX9Z6FgdLxffSjWspnKnvxZ3p3vFLcerQX5rJg15eu0unYwigrbIPqOhsjwZUzlaL-oVERqKZct-R56n4VBgsKGptIYZ7LMmfuJMrzQM6r_2y71Lbm1Fb8sGLViWjSYsnbI0Y%3D)**

Whether you can donate $**[450 or just $4.50,](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=42e444882b2e44dcba1868ed23e83c9e&_e=KT5G82Ax3C57ISm35TijQP76fIq06YKDZ3-THi1N452IvS8Dd-1wyr_0yjIjGvNHurTwQTiWfZnqh2U5xFhLsDnggrbTeHm_SCGIObSpz3YtQj8xyVVtWvzpaWX_exzVIEefG170aoaE56cOJdeUwbJkED7e31vq3g5wz4j9kYv6dAc-vUmrU_kz2VBiL8TwWkllTicObaHnQ4xf21MlYp4EosJ9wGo1f_-4OAnnjpgUITNeQEXpQg10H7IBrKC96cPU5dHoVoFxaLKr3NzcdQ3xtZNWgXixy0D-bcI4N-duKSr3bim-xpCPbR0fYwq6IMGx0Vfm2EIG2aiBb4NpbkLa2tEYGLaAmXG8jagcCtRFqlOj4lqnuHAhh2698KJ-pVnSDXncU5xkJ9TWL_CEL0__z0vKofyTHCK7g8hsqXY%3D)** everything helps. body:
As climate change causes more severe weather, The Epoch Times peddles misinformation

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85783047/475875918/2130526953?refcode=emwrapper&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTRjOTAxYjUtMjQxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1wpaSaoR8RF3aOXxvG4mfewuefoEk-y48zCSuvfn4-w=&emci=a147a3ab-241d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&emdi=14c901b5-241d-ef11-86d0-6045bdd9e096&ceid=14016711)
Peter,
Memorial Day weekend is over, and while millions got outside to enjoy the warm weather, Americans in the heartland and East Coast experienced a wave of tragic extreme weather that killed at least 20 and left many communities in ruins.
Scientists say severe weather is becoming more common because of climate change. Polls say Americans agree with the scientific consensus and want to take action to end the climate crisis, but right-wing media and politicians like Donald Trump are doing everything they can to smear climate change as a “hoax.”
**Take for example, the right-wing propaganda outlet _The Epoch Times_ , who was recently exposed for running dangerously misleading Facebook ads smearing climate change activism and spreading blatantly false information about C02 emissions:**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85783050/475875921/-593472309?refcode=20240528-EM-EpochClimateChange&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTRjOTAxYjUtMjQxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1wpaSaoR8RF3aOXxvG4mfewuefoEk-y48zCSuvfn4-w=)
**[We’ll remind you about _The Epoch Times_ and their right-wing mission in a second, but if you’re ready to fight back against climate change misinformation, can you chip in $15?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85783053/475875951/-593472309?refcode=20240528-EM-EpochClimateChange&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTRjOTAxYjUtMjQxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1wpaSaoR8RF3aOXxvG4mfewuefoEk-y48zCSuvfn4-w=)**
As a refresher, _The Epoch Times_ is one of the most successful right-wing news organizations out there right now. Primarily a propaganda and conspiracy theory site, _The Epoch Times_ spent more money on advertising for Donald Trump than any organization outside the Trump campaign in 2020.
They’re also the people behind these bizarre “#1 trusted news” billboards that have been popping up all over the country:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/85783056/475875954/-593472309?refcode=20240528-EM-EpochClimateChange&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMTRjOTAxYjUtMjQxZC1lZjExLTg2ZDAtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=1wpaSaoR8RF3aOXxvG4mfewuefoEk-y48zCSuvfn4-w=)
The marketing might be a joke, but _The Epoch Times_ ’ impact shouldn’t be taken lightly. From spreading misinformation about the COVID-19 vaccine to pushing the election lies that led to January 6th, _The Epoch Times_ is having incredible success convincing the public to believe right-wing conspiracies.
**That’s why their latest focus on spreading climate misinformation is so alarming. Climate change is an existential threat, and to combat it effectively, we need a well-informed public. It's crucial that everyone understands the severity of the threat and the damage it's causing, such as the severe weather we experienced this Memorial Day weekend.**
At COURIER, we have a strategy to stop _The Epoch Times_ and right-wing propaganda in their tracks. Our innovative news model works particularly well for climate change because its on-the-ground impact is inherently local, and we provide trustworthy, local coverage to communities that are vulnerable to propaganda campaigns from _The Epoch Times_.
And to make sure everyone has access to our reporting, we offer all our news for free in the spaces where right-wing lies spread. No paywalls, no subscriptions.

Scientists say severe weather is becoming more common because of climate change. Polls say Americans agree with the scientific consensus and want to take action to end the climate crisis, but right-wing media and politicians like Donald Trump are doing everything they can to smear climate change as a “hoax.” Take for example, the right-wing propaganda outlet The Epoch Times , who was recently exposed for running dangerously misleading Facebook ads smearing climate change activism and spreading blatantly false information about C02 emissions: = = As a refresher, The Epoch Times is one of the most successful right-wing news organizations out there right now. Primarily a propaganda and conspiracy theory site, The Epoch Times spent more money on advertising for Donald Trump than any organization outside the Trump campaign in 2020. They’re also the people behind these bizarre “#1 trusted news” billboards that have been popping up all over the country: = The marketing might be a joke, but The Epoch Times ’ impact shouldn’t be taken lightly. From spreading misinformation about the COVID-19 vaccine to pushing the election lies that led to January 6th, The Epoch Times is having incredible success convincing the public to believe right-wing conspiracies. That’s why their latest focus on spreading climate misinformation is so alarming. Climate change is an existential threat, and to combat it effectively, we need a well-informed public. It's crucial that everyone understands the severity of the threat and the damage it's causing, such as the severe weather we experienced this Memorial Day weekend. ---
Dear Peter,

I was recently visiting with my 95-year old father (his name is Ed, and he lives in sunny Boca Raton, so he is known as BocaEddy) and he reminded me about a photo that — well I just had to share it with you.

Here you go. Me at 13, in all my “glory” at my Bar Mitzvah:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85783728/475878586/1649325331?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240528_1_2&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUxZTM3ZGM2LTI1MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xmcSarimPoop4eAsjfQmeDEDfc91VE9hKI4cvok3MeE=)
I’ll admit, it’s easy to chuckle at this photo — the classic 1970s bow tie, the braces, the yarmulke, the looks — but it is also an opportunity to tell you a little about how I approach my faith.

Throughout my career in public service, I’ve thought a lot about the Jewish tradition of “Tikkun Olam,” or repairing the world. And over the last few years, there has been a lot that was broken, and a lot to fix. It’s been my cause.

**Before I go any further, and while I still have your attention, I have to ask** — [ will you click this link and pitch in a few dollars to split between Defeat Republicans and my campaign?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/85783732/475878597/1649325331?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240528_1_2&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjUxZTM3ZGM2LTI1MWQtZWYxMS04NmQwLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=xmcSarimPoop4eAsjfQmeDEDfc91VE9hKI4cvok3MeE=) If you are not ready yet or need more convincing, please read on. I have lots to share and more to say. I think you’ll like it.

I want to take you back to 1973. Our family moved around a lot because my father was in the “schmata” business. He started as a traveling salesman, and later worked as a regional manager for a men’s clothing company.

We moved from Massachusetts where I was born, lived a few years in Arizona, and ended up in the Bay Area. It was there where my dad got out of the clothing business and bought a lumber yard, where I worked during the summers. There’s nothing like hauling sheets of plywood and roofing, and shoveling concrete to make you want to go to graduate school.

| Fellow Patriot,

You've probably noticed that children today aren't getting the same kind of education that you and I received when we were growing up.

We used to be taught to love our nation, cherish our history, and respect our fellow Americans. But all of that has changed.

In today's classroom, children are taught that America is fundamentally racist, that our history is one of oppression, and that we should focus on our differences instead of what unites us.

[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0792c14ab03744e49737a7807327d473&_e=s0dUqoO6U4tgD2pS5LRETDzGXG1uAoIRTCXiNy-X0nU-TRN0KQcsFXhAtAJ9E16OTpyhVPHp_MurHqjXjIf71K_Oo2_E9432ZPgEpHOLnKiOor6frJwDw54YLiAB7E8c2IpJ3Tsmt9MnTD1uCqLOZAWdswbMLdZ9CHI9eSBy_HZaFCB0-l5zguXQX4gk6FlRcgk8D22gm58nm1RstiAIyzYOx1gWt50zB2DaIP573I_lWI5E5Um502edwaY3E4XrosoqNhiWQ_m9Alr8zfqzrGsJmNy64mldUlyhtMaXKk4VbvpmEW8SDe03aJ2lfbH7OOR44cOFTiXzs0zBFqJqj90qBkCRQNOXYHJCqe0Ei97atilHDWFolbeyY2Jwa9WxINmSRIj8mEopvBgAaZ4lhA%3D%3D)
__To make matters worse: the right of parents to choose how and where their kids receive their education remains out of reach for most American families.

And this is exactly why we created our Little Patriots program--to give parents, grandparents, teachers, and caregivers a free online resource they can use to teach children unbiased civics lessons, history, and American values, anywhere and anytime--[completely free of charge.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0792c14ab03744e49737a7807327d473&_e=s0dUqoO6U4tgD2pS5LRETDzGXG1uAoIRTCXiNy-X0nU-TRN0KQcsFXhAtAJ9E16OTpyhVPHp_MurHqjXjIf71K_Oo2_E9432ZPgEpHOLnKiOor6frJwDw54YLiAB7E8c2IpJ3Tsmt9MnTD1uCqLOZAWdswbMLdZ9CHI9eSBy_HZaFCB0-l5zguXQX4gk6FlRcgk8D22gm58nm1RstiAIyzYOx1gWt50zB2DaIP573I_lWI5E5Um502edwaY3E4Xrc1rAdpO8I0p31ngQ782sdiRbZWnP-mhIiOKZhWS_VHbgQANcDb-m89LIPd-zyZ6AQbgRY6syIPLQjeHXA7SgmJormGuzVCB8JIVrXIeCPQnPpnuyzRcM_SzLFEVGringPU4bY_DDy8sREUmEmpaZxg%3D%3D)

**And now we plan to do even more.**

To meet the growing demand for educational resources that teach children to love their country and its history, we're taking Little Patriots on the road to bring these educational resources to schools, churches, and community organizations!

But to help us fund this coast-to-coast effort, I need your help today.

We depend on the generous support of patriots like you to help us fund this program and share it with children and families across our great nation.

If you believe that American children deserve to receive the best education possible, [can I personally ask you to help me accomplish my goal of getting this first-of-its-kind curriculum to anyone who needs it?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0792c14ab03744e49737a7807327d473&_e=s0dUqoO6U4tgD2pS5LRETDzGXG1uAoIRTCXiNy-X0nU-TRN0KQcsFXhAtAJ9E16OTpyhVPHp_MurHqjXjIf71K_Oo2_E9432ZPgEpHOLnKiOor6frJwDw54YLiAB7E8c2IpJ3Tsmt9MnTD1uCqLOZAWdswbMLdZ9CHI9eSBy_HZaFCB0-l5zguXQX4gk6FlRcgk8D22gm58nm1RstiAIyzYOx1gWt50zB2DaIP573I_lWI5E5Um502edwaY3E4XrdygwtDd2I9sShB-6a5Dz6RrQp6lrLQO-6GgIitcVQlhk8__rZlBa81U6Z965O2_IV6BoGHGh4ICTdod89rOqhZGhjv93YZ2VVywGqUTNpYYO1D1lhff8xP5Wh2OK6m6iCTGfbunVE_YqoUD-lkdvgQ%3D%3D)

If you'd like to help me get Little Patriots to more American children, please click the link below to make your generous tax-deductible gift today:

[**https://secure.americancornerstone.org/little-patriots-tour-donate**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0792c14ab03744e49737a7807327d473&_e=s0dUqoO6U4tgD2pS5LRETDzGXG1uAoIRTCXiNy-X0nU-TRN0KQcsFXhAtAJ9E16OTpyhVPHp_MurHqjXjIf71K_Oo2_E9432ZPgEpHOLnKiOor6frJwDw54YLiAB7E8c2IpJ3Tsmt9MnTD1uCqLOZAWdswbMLdZ9CHI9eSBy_HZaFCB0-l5zguXQX4gk6FlRcgk8D22gm58nm1RstiAIyzYOx1gWt50zB2DaIP573I_lWI5E5Um502edwaY3E4XrXdZnkg1KvD9xMDwZcy53aKXImvvxQD82KLg10g71k_fl9fETJWp5DSD20O01S_QW1jcN6tYfrAhDZ5W2De5qka4lPH6fBpbY_Xeuq-MTpp2msOhVhZYdLlBsURs08PokfqGPQog49JKFgm1id5hoCw%3D%3D)

Thank you so much for supporting these efforts--[together we can help kids across the U.S. get the education they deserve.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=0792c14ab03744e49737a7807327d473&_e=s0dUqoO6U4tgD2pS5LRETDzGXG1uAoIRTCXiNy-X0nU-TRN0KQcsFXhAtAJ9E16OTpyhVPHp_MurHqjXjIf71K_Oo2_E9432ZPgEpHOLnKiOor6frJwDw54YLiAB7E8c2IpJ3Tsmt9MnTD1uCqLOZAWdswbMLdZ9CHI9eSBy_HZaFCB0-l5zguXQX4gk6FlRcgk8D22gm58nm1RstiAIyzYOx1gWt50zB2DaIP573I_lWI5E5Um502edwaY3E4XrjIOQPCgt0Is8Ftegaad0tWAQKEchxCnRDQEY7iZC2aC8cqS4RGZUFnHixs3f5YuB0SqiFBowgYcdCuSA-T5-dy8V9bjQfJ-gAZS_RZ5leDj-FvR8aaTaFunDYagsibCNz_DKUBykZbH8L0VCbgznVg%3D%3D)

In order to change the world, we need to recognize what we’re up against.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240528-3923-footer&t=1&akid=3923%2E420207%2E97UKXu)
Peter,
In order to change the world, we need to recognize what we’re up against.
It’s not just the looming threat of Donald Trump. There are historic levels of wealth inequality. A housing crisis that has reached a fever pitch. The war in Gaza rages on, all while the majority of people support a permanent ceasefire.
The list goes on.
**But amidst it all, one thing is clear — there is hope.**
We’ve taken on the most powerful special interests our country has ever known and we’ve defeated them time and time again — because that is what we do! And we will do it again — **but we need your help.**
We need you to join our movement. We need you to pitch in to help build our grassroots campaign. Your work will not only support our campaign, you will help strengthen our progressive movement nationwide.
I know some of you reading this want to sit this election out right now. You may be frustrated with the status quo — and rightfully so! You’re right to be angry about the relentless attacks on our democracy, our rights, and our humanity. But I believe we can do it, and we must do it.
**This is a battle for our democracy. Our campaign must remain a voice of progressive power and a beacon of hope.**[**Will you support this movement with a donation of $3 today?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240528.4HdQjj&refcode=em20240528-3923&t=2&akid=3923%2E420207%2E97UKXu)

body:
Tina for Oregon [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92654/images/TinaForOregon-Logo-FullColor-white.png]
Hi Peter,
Welcome to my team’s monthly newsletter of what I’ve been up to this month, so you can be in the loop about the great work happening.
I know life can be busy, and your inbox can get filled up with political emails, so I appreciate any time you can dedicate to reading this newsletter each month.
Thanks!
— TK

We’re making progress on the housing crisis.

Governor Tina Kotek signs four new housing bills into law [https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/gejpsMEDBBKk6rJnNODv_UjD6An43dXVdmj6S8GRSr71PNz2SBOx8Dxsogzx6eRGVDERornCfbMgH8mxXdFEUPI9ipamno8g_0OvPt9VQQ8dxUDrtmFMS6-a3bZIHmZmlEp2hcsSFjSmygF-kEt2UOA]

Governor Kotek ceremonially signed four new housing bills in North Portland at the construction site for Tistilal Village, a 57-unit affordable housing development that is being redeveloped to serve Native American families, including those experiencing homelessness. The bills will be key to creating healthier and safer communities and supporting economic growth.

Tina and Aimee Visit the Confederated Tribes of the Grand Ronde!

Governor Kotek and First Lady Aimee Kotek with members of the Confederated Tribes of the Grand Ronde [https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/2Mmtz2Z0x_pg2824EhehSxEEcfQ1qlYWuks8Hc7RpIK8Ylzcr36xiqagQKyfcOatzlCu_4J4JroN02TZg1etUnqfOpjUCLNwitgBl61OquqR2JXFAliOPg_YY9-lHrtl0a7y94_wzgIDmRr3t5P0ehs]

Governor Kotek and First Lady Aimee Kotek Wilson spent the day with the Confederated Tribes of the Grand Ronde. The day was part of Governor Kotek’s commitment to visit with all of Oregon’s nine federally recognized sovereign Tribal nations in 2024.

We’re expanding Dolly’s Library!

https://www.opb.org/article/2024/03/28/oregon-governor-kotek-signs-strong-tech-right-to-repair-bill/ [https://www.opb.org/article/2024/03/28/oregon-governor-kotek-signs-strong-tech-right-to-repair-bill/]

The program’s mission is to inspire a love of reading by providing universal access to FREE books each month for children ages 0 to 5 years old throughout Oregon!

Thanks for tuning in to this month’s edition of Team Tina’s Newsletter. Please forward this to a friend to help us reach more Oregonians — and if someone forwarded you this message, sign up to keep receiving updates here! [https://secure.ngpvan.com/mtRcnQw5MUCpt68XOFey3w2]

Thanks, team. Talk soon!

— Team Tina

Governor Tina Kotek signs four new housing bills into law [] Governor Kotek ceremonially signed four new housing bills in North Portland at the construction site for Tistilal Village, a 57-unit affordable housing development that is being redeveloped to serve Native American families, including those experiencing homelessness. The bills will be key to creating healthier and safer communities and supporting economic growth. Tina and Aimee Visit the Confederated Tribes of the Grand Ronde! Governor Kotek and First Lady Aimee Kotek with members of the Confederated Tribes of the Grand Ronde [] Governor Kotek and First Lady Aimee Kotek Wilson spent the day with the Confederated Tribes of the Grand Ronde. The day was part of Governor Kotek’s commitment to visit with all of Oregon’s nine federally recognized sovereign Tribal nations in 2024. We’re expanding Dolly’s Library! [] The program’s mission is to inspire a love of reading by providing universal access to FREE books each month for children ages 0 to 5 years old throughout Oregon! Thanks for tuning in to this month’s edition of Team Tina’s Newsletter. Please forward this to a friend to help us reach more Oregonians — and if someone forwarded you this message, sign up to keep receiving updates here! [] Thanks, team. subject: If there's one thing I admire about my husband…

body:

Friend, it's Lorena, Vicente's wife.
After being happily married to Vicente for years, there's one thing I truly admire about him: his passion for helping out everyone in our community.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240528_em_fr_b1_LG_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240528_em_fr_b1_LG_NGP]
Vicente has always been dedicated to making a difference in people's lives.
When he became an attorney, it was very important for him to defend the interests of our community members. That's why he focused his practice on fighting for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility.
I will never forget the time he was able to help a family in need by securing funds to repair their roof after a severe storm, ensuring they had a safe place to live.
As our representative for Texas' 34th Congressional District, Vicente continues to prioritize our community's needs. He's secured federal funding for our local infrastructure and has been a strong advocate for our veterans, students, and working families.
Friend, Vicente has always been there for our community. Now, I want to show him how proud I am and how strong his coalition of supporters is. But to do this, I need your support.
With just a few days until Vicente's End of Month Fundraising Deadline, his team mentioned that they still need to raise $18,117 more online to meet their goal. Can you stand with Vicente and help reach the campaign's End of Month Fundraising Goal by donating today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240528_em_fr_b1_LG_NGP]
SUPPORT VICENTE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240528_em_fr_b1_LG_NGP]
Thank you so much for standing with Vicente,
Lorena Gonzalez
Vicente Gonzalez, a life-long Democrat, is a candidate for Texas’ 34th U.S. Congressional District.
From humble beginnings, Vicente was raised in a military family. Through hard work and pure ganas, Vicente aimed to make something of himself. His mother stressed to him over and over again that education was the key that will open doors of opportunities. Vicente made the decision to get his life back on track by going back to school to get his GED, working and attending classes at community college, and earning his college degree alongside other military families at the Embry Riddle Aeronautical University on the Corpus Christi Naval Air Station. Vicente surpassed his and his parents' dreams when he graduated from Texas A&M School of Law, earning his Juris Doctorate degree.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240528_em_fr_b1_LG_NGP [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vgonzalez-email?refcode=20240528_em_fr_b1_LG_NGP]
While in law school, Vicente learned how government should work. Through his experience as a Congressional Intern in Washington, D.C., Vicente learned how government really works. After law school, Vicente didn’t stop learning, and continued his training in Negotiation at Harvard University School of Law.
Vicente started his business, the Law Offices of V. Gonzalez and Associates, in McAllen and married Lorena Saenz, a former teacher and administrator in Edinburg and McAllen schools. Vicente has focused his practice on fighting for a level playing field for working families wronged by corporations and insurance companies evading responsibility. Through several victories for our community, Vicente recovered millions in tax dollars for South Texas school districts after shady contractors misspent millions in bond money and put our children in physical danger.
Today, Vicente Gonzalez is fighting for our South Texas values in Congress as a member of the Committees on Financial Services and Foreign Affairs and the Select Committee on Economic Disparity and Fairness in Growth. Vicente has stood by our promise to veterans, helping constituents cut through red tape at the VA and working across the aisle to prevent the shameful deportation of our honorably discharged veterans. He’s working to lower prescription drug prices, protect the benefits and healthcare of seniors, and ensure that jobs and opportunities are there for all with the ganas to work.

ANCHORAGE, AK - In case you missed it, Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom
spoke with the Fairbanks Daily News-Miner
<https://platform.gulfpartyline.com/email/go?c=68282&s=93E87E38-2FE8-4BC
3-A904-E168017696C1&u=60582> about her run for Congress, the economy,
and the need for natural resource development in Alaska.

"We should be leading the nation in oil and gas development," said Lt.
Governor Dahlstrom. "We have tons of gas and oil in the ground and we
just need to drill and get it out. . Renewables are great but I'm
confident we cannot rely just on renewables. The perfect thing is a
blend of the renewables with oil and gas. We can take all the power
from turbines and solar and that can feed into the system to help
people."

"Everything we need to run equipment and computers and cellphones are
things in the ground in Alaska," said Dahlstrom. "We don't need to get
them from other countries, but when Alaskans are not allowed the
opportunity to work through a permit process or develop their lands, it
makes us dependent on other countries, specifically China."

In closing, Lt. Governor Dahlstrom said, "We have to put Alaska first
... and putting Alaska first is the only way that our Congressperson
should be."

You can read Lt. Governor Dahlstrom's full interview with the Fairbanks
Daily News-Miner here

---
** Exclusive Updates and Behind-the-Scenes Snaps from Chuck's Campaign Journey!**
|
---

**It was an honor to be in my hometown of Salem this Memorial Day, paying tribute to the men and women who made the ultimate sacrifice for our country. May God bless our fallen heroes.**

|
---
****
**It was phenomenal to join Communities for Alcohol- and Drug-Free Youth for their Annual Prevention Summit in Plymouth!**

|
---
**
****Real leadership means finding responsible solutions, and I've always believed in a community-based approach.**
****
**I had a wonderful time touring the Plaistow Community YMCA and sitting down with their Executive Director, Barbara Gallagher. It was informative to learn more about their early learning programs and childcare opportunities! I look forward to finding a solution to boost childcare options across our Granite State.**

|
---
****
**What an incredible opportunity it was to join my friend Tricia and her son Tommy for the ribbon-cutting of Bridging the Horizons' new space in Hampstead!**
****
**This center will be an amazing resource for children and adults with special needs, and I am so grateful for Tricia 's passionate leadership in creating this opportunity.**
|
---
****
**Some highlights from the ribbon cutting of Salem 's new pavilion at the Field of Dreams!**
|

me if you could read through it.

I want to outline our campaign message going forward for the General
Election to fill Maryland’s open U.S. Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major
components:

Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why national Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this
race. But during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by
the many, not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win in
November.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage
and legislation to benefit unions and workers.

He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing
control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham.

On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all
wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him
this seat.

Make the Case for a Democratic Senate Majority

Here’s the truth,
Peter: There simply isn’t any
way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins
this open seat.

Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as
his best chance to flip a seat, retake the majority, and enact his
far-right, anti-choice agenda.

If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national
abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our
elections, and so much more.

Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive
rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only
way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our
democracy.

We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters,
Peter, and I need your support
to make sure everyone hears it. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/25990?t=1012&amount=25&akid=1747%2E52803%2E4Jm3-7 ]Can I count on you to chip in $25

resources we need to reach Marylanders across the state?

name: Taking the Hill
subject: Memorial Day Recap
body:
https://www.takingthehillpac.com/ [https://www.takingthehillpac.com/]
Friend,
Now with the 'official start of summer' behind us, sharing this morning video with the American heroes from our time at the National Veterans Museum and Memorial yesterday - the new home of the brave!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hC54VkE7RY4 [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hC54VkE7RY4]
30 years after 'The Battle of Magadishu' - where Task Force Ranger faced 10 to 1 odds in an 18 hour firefight, losing 19 men, but upholding the ethos of leaving no one behind, I had the honor to reflect with many of them over the weekend - including the daughter of Army Ranger 1SG Glenn Harris, Tara Harris, here with me presenting this wreath.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/NVMMWreath.jpeg]
Hope your week is off to a great start and our paths cross soon.
PS Join or support us in DC next Wednesday night if you can invest in the next generation of Veterans entering into political public service - Taking the Hill event with Navy Veteran/Congresswoman Mikie Sherill, Army Veteran/Congressman Pat Ryan, and House Armed Services Committee Ranking Member Adam Smith.

name: Sarah McBride
subject: I’ll do things a little different in Congress
body:
Can you believe the kind of things House Republicans are spending all their time on?
#
Can you believe the kind of things House Republicans are spending all their time on in Congress right now?
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240528-1?refcode=em20240528-1&amount=5&refcode2=515_21716_KGk3xa&akid=515%2E21716%2EKGk3xa)
— NBC News
They’re so worried about getting a “win” for their base that they’re spending all their time deposing Speakers, voting on new ones, threatening to shut down the government, and conducting politically motivated investigations.
Meanwhile, the American people are left wondering when they’re going to get around to addressing the things we _actually_ care about: **making health care more accessible, preventing gun violence, protecting abortion rights, and so much more.**
I think it’s safe to say that I plan to do things a little different from how Republicans are doing them as Delaware’s next Member of Congress... [**Will you pitch in $5 toward our $10,000 end-of-month goal so we can take back the House and start making progress on _real_ issues?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240528-1?refcode=em20240528-1&amount=5&refcode2=515_21716_KGk3xa&akid=515%2E21716%2EKGk3xa)
In Delaware, I hit the ground running the moment I got to the State Senate. And we have results to prove it!
We’ve passed legislation to expand access to health care, guarantee paid family and medical leave, improve our public schools, give raises to our teachers, and keep our communities safe from gun violence.
**To me, politics has _never_ been about grandstanding the way House Republicans are. It’s always been about doing the hard work of improving people's lives.**
[**I want to do that work for Delaware and for all Americans in Congress, but I need your help to get there. Will you pitch in $5 today to help me keep building this grassroots campaign?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240528-1?refcode=em20240528-1&amount=5&refcode2=515_21716_KGk3xa&akid=515%2E21716%2EKGk3xa)

Sarah McBride

Friends —
When Mark Kelly thinks about the people who have been his top supporters over the last few years, it’s not just the people who write the biggest checks who come to mind.
It’s the people who were there when everything was on the line.
Like you.

But here’s something we thought you should know: Out of all the people who read these emails, less than 25% of them have made a donation to support his work.
Today, we’re asking you to join them.

I address this and more in the series we are going through at [Sheridan.Church](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=11045289.5576.1.fa8f45211912a3cf54a5cb67f25bebfb) over the[Gospel of Matthew](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=11045289.5577.1.64f2ec522b16c9286ae18a1b76d7cc05). body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/repryanchamberlin/official-newsletter-12695770?e=d1c1b9864f)
---
| |
---
| | **WEEKLY UPDATE FROM REP. RYAN CHAMBERLIN**
---
| My Fellow Floridians,

I hope you enjoyed a meaningful **Memorial Day** weekend! Thank you for joining me for another update on the work I’m doing in **House District 24**. It was a pleasure spending time with constituents and learning more about how I can make our state and community even better. This is just the beginning! I look forward to continuing my efforts alongside my colleagues in the **Florida Legislature** to build on our good work for the people we serve in the next legislative session.

If there is something I can do for you, please do not hesitate to get in touch with my office. I want to work with you to build a brighter future for Florida and our district. **You can contact my office by[clicking here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=0e316a7c11&e=d1c1b9864f). **We would be happy to assist you in any way we can!
---
| | **Monday, May 20 - Community Foundation of Ocala and Marion County Tour**
---
|
---
---
| Thank you to the board members and staff at the **Community Foundation Ocala Marion County** for taking the time to show me around the facility. It was great to hear more about the different programs and non-profit partnerships they have going on out in our community. We appreciate everything they do and look forward to working with them in the future to serve the residents of Marion County.
---
| | **Tuesday, May 21 - Meetings in Tallahassee**
---
|
---
| I had the opportunity to be back in **Tallahassee** for some important meetings to discuss legislation for the upcoming **2025 Legislative Session**. I’m very excited about the next steps we will take to keep our state the **Free State of Florida**. I look forward to keeping you updated on our progress.
---
| | **Wednesday, May 22 - Mental Health Talk at Horse and Hounds Restaurant**
---
|
---
| It was great to meet with a group at **Horse and Hounds Restaurant** to discuss mental health in the state of Florida. I greatly appreciated those who attended the meeting to have important conversations about this topic. In the **State House** , I will always fight for new and improved resources and additional support for the Floridians facing mental health challenges.
---
| | **2024 Legislative Report Card**
---
|
---
| I’m very proud to share with the community that I received 100% on my **Florida Chamber Report Card** for my work during the **2024 Legislative Session**. It was an honor to support pro-business policies in the legislature that will grow and strengthen our state and local economies. Learn more about my score [here](https://voteryanchamberlin.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ec15c6093052c02efbd22b6cd&id=92034a269e&e=d1c1b9864f)!
---
| | **Memorial Day 2024**
---
|
---
| I hope you enjoyed a meaningful **Memorial Day** with friends and family. This was a day for us to remember and honor the sacrifices made by the brave men and women in our **Armed Forces** who laid down their lives to defend our great nation and the freedoms we enjoy here. In the **Florida House** , I’m committed to being a champion for our active military members and veterans. We owe them so much and should never take their service for granted.
---
|
---
| | Thank you for electing me to serve **House District 24** in the Florida Legislature! I’m incredibly honored to be your voice in **Tallahassee**. As always, if anyone has any questions or concerns, please don’t hesitate to reach out. My office would be happy to help you in any way we can.

Have a wonderful week!

Best regards,

**Ryan Chamberlin**
******State Representative**
**District 24**
